伯林特綜合醫院診療部部長──傑瑞德，因妒忌優秀又受人愛戴的洛伊德搶走了自己的地位，便處心積慮地對他百般刁難。即使如此，洛伊德的名聲依舊毫無動搖，這讓傑瑞德更加憤恨不平。最終，他竟然捏造洛伊德是間諜的罪名，向保安局舉報…
安妮亞要去參加社會科戶外教學。在搭乘校車前往的途中，她滿懷幹勁地準備對達米安展開「好朋友作戰」，卻總是不順利。就在這時，激進派組織「赤紅馬戲團」竟然劫持了校車…

programme.title: Talker - Superstitiously Correct E27 / 晚吹 - 講玄 第27集
programme.desc: 本節目將以全新方式探討玄學議題，旨在打破傳統框架，提供多元視角。主持 人達哥（林慧韡）、米露迪、Lucas T.（李進偉），從不同角度深入討論與玄學相關的主題。 每集將邀請不同領域的玄學家作為嘉賓，促進激烈且富有深度的觀點交流，在 理性數據分析的支持下，挑戰迷信並鼓勵觀眾獨立思考。不僅吸引對神秘學感興趣的 觀眾，亦針對喜愛邏輯分析與觀點辯論的人群，提供豐富的內容。 討論主題將緊貼都市熱話，易於引發社交媒體上的討論並激起大眾共鳴。透過 這樣的對話，節目旨在滿足觀眾的好奇心，並提供生活指引，幫助觀眾更加明智地面 對生活中的不確定性。

Medicine Online E544 / 杏林在線 第544集
programme.desc: 《杏林在線》採訪團隊每星期走訪各醫院的手術室及實驗室，深度探討不同的醫學問題，以及介紹各種醫療新科技，請來專家剖析和真實個案分享。我們的醫學顧問每集亦會為觀眾解答疑難。

programme.title: News Cast at 6 with Sign Language / 6點新聞報道 (手語新聞)

Let's travel around the world E347 -上海中西甜品｜侯斯頓療癒農場 / 730 玩返轉 第347集 - 上海中西甜品｜侯斯頓療癒農場
programme.desc: 《730 玩返轉》CK 一嚐上海試中西融合甜品，看廚師如何把熟悉味道重新組合，為甜點添上城市性格。Chris分享私心泰國美食清單，並私心推薦當地「特色」街頭小食，他更帶來幾款值得一試的滋味，讓餐桌交流更添趣味。Shereen帶大家到訪侯斯頓的特色農場，在簡約鄉村日常中享受放慢步伐的療癒感。

programme.title: The Cooking Lab E36 / 煮題研習社 第36集
programme.desc: 每集針對特定的「料理主題（煮題）」展開研習，帶出神還原的廚藝技巧、食材搭配知識與生活實用資訊。透過每集不同的「煮題」研習，讓觀眾看清美食背後的訣竅，輕鬆在家重現各種美味！

programme.title: Namib E5 / 我的明星製作人 第5集
programme.desc: 振宇意識到自己在車禍中丟掉了秀賢的名片。即使發現振宇一焦慮就會自殘，秀賢仍繼續訓練他。

programme.title: Phantom Lawyer E21 / 神與律師事務所 第21集
programme.desc: 在起仲的幫助下，以朗和娜賢擊敗了破壞他們辦公室的歹徒。然而，歹徒頭目搶走了錄音機。為了找回錄音機，以朗和娜賢再次前往中國城…

programme.title: UA Finance Presents: The Making of Long Vacation: Starting Over E5 / 悠長假期 重新出發 第5集
WeWa Card Presents: Hong Kong's Warmest Delicacies in Europe E15 -⁠⁠More Than A Pint II / 港出好味道 第15集 - ⁠⁠More Than A Pint II
programme.desc: <港出好味道>最終回! 手工啤酒吧東主Brian和Priscilla帶主持到訪Altrincham另一間由港人經營的Café，品嚐精品咖啡、麵包和甜點。三位主持其後到酒吧做一日店長，試飲多款啤酒，當然包括具香港特色口味的手工啤酒！她們更與酒客瘋狂互動，務求令酒吧生意衝上高峰！

programme.title: Talker - One Beside You 3 E465 -李法進師傅分享靈異個案 / 晚吹 - 總有一瓣喺左近 第465集 - 李法進師傅分享靈異個案
programme.desc: 人人都想愛情得意，但人人真的可以感情生活美滿？不少人都會拜姻緣求個好對象，但如果急於尋求慰藉而亂拜神，吸引不到對象之餘更有機惹來一身蟻，今集嘉賓李法進師傅分享的個案，事主沉迷與姻緣靈牌交感，最終無法抽身。

programme.title: 3 mins Enews E1499 / 3 分鐘熱度 第1499集
programme.desc: 娛樂資訊節目《3分鐘熱度》是ViuTV一個自家製作，集娛樂圈消息及熱話的精華式娛樂資訊節目，以明快節奏、幽默角度報道本港及海外演藝界最新動態，快而準追蹤娛樂圈消息。

programme.title: Love's Ambition (Bilingual) E3 / 許我耀眼 第3集
programme.desc: 許妍通過策劃節目，成功贏得于嵐和其朋友的認可，節目收視率大漲。沈家聚會時，電視新聞曝光大雲縣商業街改造項目，許妍神色緊張。 沈金松詢問許妍是否去過大雲縣，許妍否認。

programme.title: Bitter Sweet Hell (Bilingual) E13 / 我們，家 第13集
programme.desc: 盧英媛是大韓民國公認最優秀的家庭心理諮詢醫生，與整形外科醫生丈夫崔宰鎮是所有人都羨慕的夫妻。但突然被不明來歷的神秘女人世娜所威脅，自己曾經令人艷羨的事業與家庭一切都被徹底動搖。為了守護所有家人，開始與作為推理小說作家的家婆洪思江合作守護家人。

programme.title: The Escape of the Seven: Resurrection (Bilingual) E3 / 7人的復活 第3集
programme.desc: 於前作結尾被殺的閔道赫還沒有死去，於是決定向偽裝成整容後的Matthew，實際是被稱作「K」的盛燦集團繼承人報仇。

programme.title: The Vendetta of An (Bilingual) E23 / 長安二十四計 第23集
programme.desc: 劇情講述文承年間，虎賁暗衛在長安城盤踞多年，勢力已根深蒂固。淮南縣衙主簿謝淮安接到帝王蕭武陽的秘密詔書，被緊急調往國都長安，負責剷除姦佞。虎賁將軍言鳳山不甘心大權旁落，集結虎賁暗衛勢力，企圖分裂國家、自立為王。他利用長安城中的藏兵巷作為掩護，將暗衛分佈其中，伺機反擊。在蕭武陽的協助下，謝淮安聯合忠義將領顧玉、劍客葉崢、畫家白莞及年輕文士謝子凌等人，運用智謀搗毀藏兵巷，粉碎言鳳山妄圖裂國的陰謀，讓長安城重現風朗氣清。

programme.title: The Scarecrow (Bilingual) E4 / 稻草人 第4集
programme.desc: 故事橫跨 1988 年至 2019 年，描述王牌刑警姜泰周（朴海秀 飾）為破案重返故鄉康盛，遇上負責此案的檢察官車時英（李熙俊 飾）。兩人因目標相同卻關係緊張，不得不放下敵意，共同展開追捕行動。

programme.title: Missing Crown Prince (Bilingual) E10 / 世子消失了 第10集
programme.desc: 王世子被即將成為世子嬪的女人綁架後而發生的一系列故事，在每個瞬間都要拼上性命的逃亡路上，青春男女之間發生的波瀾萬丈，最終逃跑的故事。

programme.title: Bitter Sweet Hell (Bilingual) E14 / 我們，家 第14集
programme.desc: 盧英媛是大韓民國公認最優秀的家庭心理諮詢醫生，與整形外科醫生丈夫崔宰鎮是所有人都羨慕的夫妻。但突然被不明來歷的神秘女人世娜所威脅，自己曾經令人艷羨的事業與家庭一切都被徹底動搖。為了守護所有家人，開始與作為推理小說作家的家婆洪思江合作守護家人。

programme.title: The Escape of the Seven: Resurrection (Bilingual) E4 / 7人的復活 第4集

programme.title: The Vendetta of An (Bilingual) E24 / 長安二十四計 第24集
programme.desc: 劇情講述文承年間，虎賁暗衛在長安城盤踞多年，勢力已根深蒂固。淮南縣衙主簿謝淮安接到帝王蕭武陽的秘密詔書，被緊急調往國都長安，負責剷除姦佞。虎賁將軍言鳳山不甘心大權旁落，集結虎賁暗衛勢力，企圖分裂國家、自立為王。他利用長安城中的藏兵巷作為掩護，將暗衛分佈其中，伺機反擊。在蕭武陽的協助下，謝淮安聯合忠義將領顧玉、劍客葉崢、畫家白莞及年輕文士謝子凌等人，運用智謀搗毀藏兵巷，粉碎言鳳山妄圖裂國的陰謀，讓長安城重現風朗氣清。

programme.title: REBORN (Bilingual) E8 / 重生～最後的英雄～ 第8集
programme.desc: 故事背景設定在 2026 年，主角根尾光誠（高橋一生 飾）是一位魅力十足、正值人生巔峰的 IT 公司社長。然而，他卻突然遭遇意外，被人從樓梯上推落導致身亡。 令人意想不到的是，光誠的靈魂並沒有消失，而是跨越時空轉生回到了 14 年前 （2012 年），並附身在一名與自己長相一模一樣、名叫野本英人的青年身上。 與原本「人生勝利組」的社長身份截然不同，野本英人是一名生活在下町商店街、且負債累累的普通百姓。光誠必須以這個全新的身份，在艱難的庶民生活中掙扎求生，同時利用未來的記憶與智慧，試圖查明自己在 2026 年被殺害的真相，並展開一段守護身邊重要之人的「重生」之旅。

programme.title: Japan's Number One Jerk Salaryman (Bilingual) E8 / 日本第一的爛男人-我的假家人們 第8集
programme.desc: 主角大森一平（香取慎吾）是人生被逼到懸崖邊的前播報員，被家人和孩子討壓的最爛男人，為了選舉，和單親爸爸的妹夫及其孩子們一起生活。在面對日常生活中的家庭和社會問題的過程中，最差勁的男人一邊和妹夫和孩子們一點一點地建立起真正的家庭關係，一邊希望逐漸建立更好的社會，不久後努力參加選舉……

programme.desc: 劇情講述文承年間，虎賁暗衛在長安城盤踞多年，勢力已根深蒂固。淮南縣衙主簿謝淮安接到帝王蕭武陽的秘密詔書，被緊急調往國都長安，負責剷除姦佞。虎賁將軍言鳳山不甘心大權旁落，集結虎賁暗衛勢力，企圖分裂國家、自立為王。他利用長安城中的藏兵巷作為掩護，將暗衛分佈其中，伺機反擊。在蕭武陽的協助下，謝淮安聯合忠義將領顧玉、劍客葉崢、畫家白莞及年輕文士謝子凌等人，運用智謀搗毀藏兵巷，粉碎言鳳山妄圖裂國的陰謀，讓長安城重現風朗氣清。

programme.title: REBORN (Bilingual) E8 / 重生～最後的英雄～ 第8集
programme.desc: 故事背景設定在 2026 年，主角根尾光誠（高橋一生 飾）是一位魅力十足、正值人生巔峰的 IT 公司社長。然而，他卻突然遭遇意外，被人從樓梯上推落導致身亡。 令人意想不到的是，光誠的靈魂並沒有消失，而是跨越時空轉生回到了 14 年前 （2012 年），並附身在一名與自己長相一模一樣、名叫野本英人的青年身上。 與原本「人生勝利組」的社長身份截然不同，野本英人是一名生活在下町商店街、且負債累累的普通百姓。光誠必須以這個全新的身份，在艱難的庶民生活中掙扎求生，同時利用未來的記憶與智慧，試圖查明自己在 2026 年被殺害的真相，並展開一段守護身邊重要之人的「重生」之旅。

programme.title: Canned Mackerel Heads to Space (Bilingual) E8 / 鯖魚罐頭，航向宇宙 第8集
programme.desc: 故事改編自真人真事，講述福井縣高中生忽發奇想，希望航天員可在太空站吃到鯖魚罐頭，於是研發「宇宙食品」，更獲宇宙航空研究開發機構（JAXA）認證，並成功送上國際太空站（ISS）的勵志過程。

programme.title: Private Banker (Bilingual) E4 / 私人銀行家 第4集
programme.desc: 主角安野浩一，專為資產超過10億日元的富豪服務，作為「私人銀行家」精心保護客人的財富。他的職業生涯由證券人開始並一步一步成為業界傳奇人物，管理著多名富有客戶的財富。除了資產管理之外，也用一切可能的方式來解決富裕客人面臨的問題，例如家庭成員之間的衝突。

programme.desc: 故事改編自真人真事，講述福井縣高中生忽發奇想，希望航天員可在太空站吃到鯖魚罐頭，於是研發「宇宙食品」，更獲宇宙航空研究開發機構（JAXA）認證，並成功送上國際太空站（ISS）的勵志過程。

programme.title: Private Banker (Bilingual) E4 / 私人銀行家 第4集
programme.desc: 主角安野浩一，專為資產超過10億日元的富豪服務，作為「私人銀行家」精心保護客人的財富。他的職業生涯由證券人開始並一步一步成為業界傳奇人物，管理著多名富有客戶的財富。除了資產管理之外，也用一切可能的方式來解決富裕客人面臨的問題，例如家庭成員之間的衝突。

programme.desc: 劇情講述文承年間，虎賁暗衛在長安城盤踞多年，勢力已根深蒂固。淮南縣衙主簿謝淮安接到帝王蕭武陽的秘密詔書，被緊急調往國都長安，負責剷除姦佞。虎賁將軍言鳳山不甘心大權旁落，集結虎賁暗衛勢力，企圖分裂國家、自立為王。他利用長安城中的藏兵巷作為掩護，將暗衛分佈其中，伺機反擊。在蕭武陽的協助下，謝淮安聯合忠義將領顧玉、劍客葉崢、畫家白莞及年輕文士謝子凌等人，運用智謀搗毀藏兵巷，粉碎言鳳山妄圖裂國的陰謀，讓長安城重現風朗氣清。

programme.title: The Heart 2 E15 / 問心 2 第15集
programme.desc: 兩年後，周筱風援黔歸來，被破格提拔為東立醫院史上最年輕的心內科執行主任，他與林逸、方筱然重組“三人小分隊”，在全新的職業挑戰與情感考驗中並肩作戰，面對理想與現實的衝突，繼續堅守信念“問心無愧”。

programme.title: Warm on a Cold Night E7 / 九霄寒夜暖 第7集
programme.desc: 《九霄寒夜暖》主要講述了機智女捕快蘇玖兒搭檔冷峻祺族少主寒猙探九霄迷案，展開一段甜蜜“溫差戀愛”的故事。 該劇講述了乾國“畏寒”女捕快蘇玖兒與祺族“內熱”少主寒猙因關乎兩族關係的離奇兇案相遇，機緣下組成“溫差搭檔”，攜手穿破陰謀迷霧，尋找案件背後真相的同時化解家國危機故事。

programme.title: Fox Spirit Matchmaker: Red-Moon Pact E30 / 狐妖小紅娘月紅篇 第30集
programme.desc: 塗山紅紅與塗山雅雅、塗山容容，都是出生自苦情樹孕育出來的狐族，她們肩負著守護狐族的重任。紅紅作為狐族的領袖，擁有強大的妖力，帶領狐族結緣滋養苦情樹，苦情樹再守護狐族。然而一股黑暗的力量正試圖吞噬苦情樹，為了拯救它，只有完成天書任務才能守護苦情樹。

programme.title: Unchained Love E35 / 浮圖緣 第35集
Eight Hundred E10 / 方圓八百米 第10集
programme.desc: 故事聚焦在上世紀九十年代末的豐陽小鎮礦區。一具無名女屍的出現，打破了表面的平靜，小鎮內的違禁藥品販賣網絡隨之浮出水面。警察陳紅兵緊跟線索，卻步步逼近親生兒子陳輝。在方圓八百公尺的小天地裡，父子間的對抗、職責與親情的糾纏、法律與人性的交纏，讓這個家庭與小城一同面臨善惡的抉擇與考驗。

programme.title: Lady Revenger Returns from the Fire E5 / 披荊斬棘的大小姐 第5集
programme.desc: 溫婉恬靜的羅家大小姐羅愛蓮，因突如其來的災難，一夜間失去了一切，從人間富貴花被打入泥潭。經歷重重困境，最終經歷過九死一生的羅愛蓮鳳凰涅槃成為能文能武的鏢局大小姐沈丹青（徐璐飾），從此浴火重生，踏上手撕仇人的荊棘之路，開啟了她的別樣人生。沈丹青在復仇的過程中意外闖入了尋找丟失寶藏的徐將軍（魏哲鳴飾）視野，引起他的懷疑，這使沈丹青的這條復仇之路更加跌宕起伏、與眾不同，兩人在一次次驚心動魄的鬥智中，相互成全，惺惺相惜，發生了一系列扣人心弦的故事。

programme.title: Detective Chinatown 2 E6 / 唐人街探案2 第6集
programme.desc: 《唐人街探案2》中海外再發多起奇案，唐仁大弟子林默、天才黑客Kiko紛紛登場，更有眾多新偵探新人物亮相！為探尋真相，老偵探再集結重掀唐人街風雲！懸疑故事幽默風格深刻寓意，呈現探案新潮流。

programme.title: The Heart 2 E16 / 問心 2 第16集
programme.desc: 兩年後，周筱風援黔歸來，被破格提拔為東立醫院史上最年輕的心內科執行主任，他與林逸、方筱然重組“三人小分隊”，在全新的職業挑戰與情感考驗中並肩作戰，面對理想與現實的衝突，繼續堅守信念“問心無愧”。

programme.title: Warm on a Cold Night E8 / 九霄寒夜暖 第8集
programme.desc: 《九霄寒夜暖》主要講述了機智女捕快蘇玖兒搭檔冷峻祺族少主寒猙探九霄迷案，展開一段甜蜜“溫差戀愛”的故事。 該劇講述了乾國“畏寒”女捕快蘇玖兒與祺族“內熱”少主寒猙因關乎兩族關係的離奇兇案相遇，機緣下組成“溫差搭檔”，攜手穿破陰謀迷霧，尋找案件背後真相的同時化解家國危機故事。

programme.title: Fox Spirit Matchmaker: Red-Moon Pact E31 / 狐妖小紅娘月紅篇 第31集
programme.desc: 塗山紅紅與塗山雅雅、塗山容容，都是出生自苦情樹孕育出來的狐族，她們肩負著守護狐族的重任。紅紅作為狐族的領袖，擁有強大的妖力，帶領狐族結緣滋養苦情樹，苦情樹再守護狐族。然而一股黑暗的力量正試圖吞噬苦情樹，為了拯救它，只有完成天書任務才能守護苦情樹。

programme.title: Who is the Murderer E1 / 誰是兇手 第1集
programme.desc: 《誰是兇手》講述了一起發生在海舟市的連環兇案，在真相塵封了十七年之後，與這宗懸案有著千絲萬縷聯繫的人們，在各自不可告人的秘密中，一起等待真相浮出水面的故事。 2001年寒冬，海舟市印刷廠家屬院發生了一起命案。新人刑警冷小兵和師兄接到一起報案奔赴現場，卻意外面對海舟市連環殺人案的兇手。冷小兵膽怯不敢開槍，兇手從現場逃走並殺害了師兄李嵐。現場另一名目擊證人是躲在床下的夏木。為繼續留在警隊冷小兵隱瞞了不敢開槍的事，夏木也沒有揭穿他。至此兇手藏匿起來，海舟案懸而未決。十七年後，夏木來到警隊實習，以冷小兵不敢開槍的事作為把柄，要挾他和自己一起查案。而伴随着神秘的心理医生沈雨的出现，一起几乎与十七年前一模一样的案子再次发生，而沈雨身上一个又一个疑团频频出现，凶手究竟是谁？

programme.title: Who is the Murderer E2 / 誰是兇手 第2集
programme.desc: 《誰是兇手》講述了一起發生在海舟市的連環兇案，在真相塵封了十七年之後，與這宗懸案有著千絲萬縷聯繫的人們，在各自不可告人的秘密中，一起等待真相浮出水面的故事。 2001年寒冬，海舟市印刷廠家屬院發生了一起命案。新人刑警冷小兵和師兄接到一起報案奔赴現場，卻意外面對海舟市連環殺人案的兇手。冷小兵膽怯不敢開槍，兇手從現場逃走並殺害了師兄李嵐。現場另一名目擊證人是躲在床下的夏木。為繼續留在警隊冷小兵隱瞞了不敢開槍的事，夏木也沒有揭穿他。至此兇手藏匿起來，海舟案懸而未決。十七年後，夏木來到警隊實習，以冷小兵不敢開槍的事作為把柄，要挾他和自己一起查案。而伴随着神秘的心理医生沈雨的出现，一起几乎与十七年前一模一样的案子再次发生，而沈雨身上一个又一个疑团频频出现，凶手究竟是谁？

programme.desc: 侯文詠原著小說改編，兩段糾結的情感，交織出一場關於「選擇」的情愛旅程。

programme.title: Warm on a Cold Night E12 / 九霄寒夜暖 第12集
programme.desc: 《九霄寒夜暖》主要講述了機智女捕快蘇玖兒搭檔冷峻祺族少主寒猙探九霄迷案，展開一段甜蜜“溫差戀愛”的故事。 該劇講述了乾國“畏寒”女捕快蘇玖兒與祺族“內熱”少主寒猙因關乎兩族關係的離奇兇案相遇，機緣下組成“溫差搭檔”，攜手穿破陰謀迷霧，尋找案件背後真相的同時化解家國危機故事。

programme.title: Fox Spirit Matchmaker: Red-Moon Pact E36 / 狐妖小紅娘月紅篇 第36集
programme.desc: 塗山紅紅與塗山雅雅、塗山容容，都是出生自苦情樹孕育出來的狐族，她們肩負著守護狐族的重任。紅紅作為狐族的領袖，擁有強大的妖力，帶領狐族結緣滋養苦情樹，苦情樹再守護狐族。然而一股黑暗的力量正試圖吞噬苦情樹，為了拯救它，只有完成天書任務才能守護苦情樹。

programme.desc: 由陳妍希、夏之光、高卿塵、李雅娟組成國醫少年團，帶著對中醫文化的虔誠與需求，踏上制定的研學體驗地圖，遇見不同行醫風格的中醫師，與他們同吃同住，同苦同樂，深度體驗中醫藥從業者的工作艱辛，學習簡易上手的健康養生功法，從中體驗和領悟中醫藥的博大精深。

programme.title: She Is the Phoenix (Mini drama) E8 / 迎鳳歸 (短劇) 第8集
programme.desc: 圍繞雙重生的復仇主線展開，女主角姜樂瑤慘死後重生，發現閨蜜蓉兒頂替了自己的身份嫁入寧府，前一世她被嫁給痴傻少爺，更發現父母並非死於意外而是被人所害；這一世，她與同樣重生的伙伴聯手，直面寧府權貴的迫害，在身份置換與權謀博弈中揭露真相，為自己討回公道。

programme.title: Flying Up Without Disturb (Mini drama) E57 / 勿擾飛升 (短劇) 第57集
programme.desc: 一位在凡塵界備受冷遇的亡國公主箜篌，因機緣巧合意外進入修仙世界，開啟全員寵女主模式，整個修仙界都對女主寵愛有加，為了吃苦頭，磨練心智，箜篌主動走出舒適圈，要求下山闖蕩，偶遇了病弱男子桓宗一起升級打怪闖蕩修仙界，沒想到桓宗竟然是傳說中的修仙界天才，箜篌順利把桓宗拐回了門派當女婿，兩人也在一次次的歷練中克服了心魔，突破修為，雙雙成為了一代宗師。

programme.title: United Across the Seas E5 / 四海同心 第5集
programme.desc: 追溯孫中山領導的民主革命從夏威夷開始的歷程，體現孫中山先生「華僑是革命之母」的著名論斷，真實呈現一百多年前跌宕起伏的辛亥風雲，展現海外華僑華人先輩在異鄉奮斗的艱辛及無私熱愛之情。

programme.desc: 一位在凡塵界備受冷遇的亡國公主箜篌，因機緣巧合意外進入修仙世界，開啟全員寵女主模式，整個修仙界都對女主寵愛有加，為了吃苦頭，磨練心智，箜篌主動走出舒適圈，要求下山闖蕩，偶遇了病弱男子桓宗一起升級打怪闖蕩修仙界，沒想到桓宗竟然是傳說中的修仙界天才，箜篌順利把桓宗拐回了門派當女婿，兩人也在一次次的歷練中克服了心魔，突破修為，雙雙成為了一代宗師。

programme.desc: 由陳妍希、夏之光、高卿塵、李雅娟組成國醫少年團，帶著對中醫文化的虔誠與需求，踏上制定的研學體驗地圖，遇見不同行醫風格的中醫師，與他們同吃同住，同苦同樂，深度體驗中醫藥從業者的工作艱辛，學習簡易上手的健康養生功法，從中體驗和領悟中醫藥的博大精深。

programme.title: Ben 10 S2E3 -Battle At Biggie Box / 少年勇將之再顯神威 第3集 - Battle At Biggie Box
programme.desc: Ben and Billy Billions go head-to-head over a Sumo Slammer Set sold exclusively inside the world's largest shopping centre, only to find six-year-old Simon Sez has gotten to it first.

programme.desc: Aboard the SS Pettigrew on its final voyage, Ben must battle seasickness as well as Steam Smythe, who looks to use his mechanical creatures to sink the steamship's modern replacement.

programme.desc: With new Omni-Enhancements in tow, Ben plans on saving a town from a sudden mudslide, but his heroics are short-lived once Vilgax appears to warn him about the Omnitrix's mysterious new alien.

programme.title: Ben 10 S2E6 -The 11Th Alien, Part 2 / 少年勇將之再顯神威 第6集 - The 11Th Alien, Part 2
programme.desc: After discovering that Vilgax has joined forces with the Weatherheads, Ben must not only overcome his doubts, but must also fully embrace his new powers if he is to beat his foes.

programme.title: The National Dog Show ('20)
programme.desc: From the Kennel Club of Philadelphia, this cherished competition for all dog lovers returns for the 17th year. Hosted by John O'Hurley, the event features 2,000 of the nation's leading canines, including the world’s largest, smallest and most exotic. Over 170 breeds strut their stuff with the hope of becoming this year's top dog. “The Dean” David Frei provides expert show commentary, and Mary Carillo chimes in as an adept sideline reporter for this ultimate canine showdown. programme.title: Kung Fu Panda 2 / 功夫熊貓2
programme.desc: Po (Jack Black) faces his biggest challenge since becoming the Dragon Warrior to lead The Furious Five on a mission of epic proportions and defeat his most threatening rival yet.

programme.title: Memoirs Of A Geisha / 藝伎回憶錄
programme.desc: A young Japanese girl is trained as a geisha and navigates love, rivalry and tradition before WWII.

programme.title: Terms Of Endearment / 親密關係
programme.desc: The winnder of 5 Academy Awards including Best Picture, this film follows 30 years in the life of a Texas woman, chronicling her stormy but loving relationship with her daughter, and the mother's fitful and hugely entertaining romance with a raffish ex-astronaut.

programme.title: Twins Effect, The / 千機變
programme.desc: Ace Vampire slayer Reeve and his new partner Gipsy are on this mission, however Reeve's younger sister Helen falls in love with the Vampire fifth prince Kazaf.

programme.title: The Bodyguard / 特工爺爺
programme.desc: Bodyguard, The follows a retired bodyguard (Hung) who has settled in the dark and unknown corner of the world. Suffering from the beginnings of dementia, Bodyguard, The is befriended by a young girl whose life is threatened when her father (Lau) falls in with the local crime world. When the girl and her father disappear, Bodyguard, The must call upon his long forgotten skills to save the life of his young friend.

programme.title: Rule #1 / 第一誡
programme.desc: Every day, the Police Force receives 185 phone calls.180 of them are about burglaries, murders, rapes and kidnappings. The remaining 5 begin with: “There is something strange in my house, can you please send someone over to take a look?” For rookie Sergeant Lee, being a cop means running down crooks and upholding the law. Injured in a shoot-out, he finds out to his horror that he is reassigned to the dubious-sounding Miscellaneous Affairs Department (MAD)...

programme.title: Look For A Star / 游龍戲鳳
programme.desc: It's hardly a coincidence that Sam is considered the most eligible bachelor in town. Not only is he a young, smart, and insightful entrepreneur with a coveted fortune, but he also happens to be a blithe spirit with a carefree attitude to life. However, every success has its price. Sam has already divorced three times and finds himself crawling back to the game of love sooner than he has expected. It is love at first sight when Sam chances upon a feisty, fast-talking woman with the odd name of Milan at a Macau casino. But the catch is, she is a part-time poker dealer and a full-time cabaret dancer, “careers” not exactly congruent with his station in life. Fallen in love against all odds, this mismatched couple soon makes headline in all media which turn Milan into an It girl overnight...

programme.title: Killing Romance / 浪漫特攻隊
programme.desc: Yeo-rae is a retired national superstar in Korea. During her holiday on a South Pacific Island, she gets married to Jonathan, a tycoon who she initially thought of as her prince charming but turns out to be a control freak. With the help of her neighbour Beom-wu, who happens to be a die-hard fan of Yeo-rae, she is going to get herself out of the cage with a murder plan.

programme.title: Baogu Produces -Vicious Men and Wicked Women / 爆谷製造 -狠男惡女
programme.desc: The cast of “We Are Born Good”, Yeung Wai Lun, Chung Suet Ying, and Kearen Pang, together with Director Yeung Leung Chuen, join us to discuss their lives as 'unconventional' individuals! In the interview, Suet Ying recalled that she was once harassed, prompting her to strike back by posting a public note; Wai Lun admitted that he used to fear the heavy responsibility of carrying a film as a lead actor; and Kearen shares how she once faced a 'curse' that made it difficult for her to land acting roles. Meanwhile, Leung Chuen offers warm encouragement, urging everyone to discover the small, beautiful things in life and regain their motivation! Tune in as the four of them personally unveil more surprising behind-the-scenes stories from the film.

programme.title: Napping Kid / 逆向誘拐
programme.desc: Siu-yu, a financial analyst who has been working to complete a budget analyst for an investment bank, finds that a file containing confidential information has been mysteriously deleted. Soon after, her boss, John, receives a ransom email from someone called K Kidnapper, demanding just $190,000 worth of ransom. The ransom must be paid in 3 days, otherwise they will share the information to public. Under a detective's secret investigation, everyone could be the suspect...

programme.title: Better Days / 少年的你
programme.desc: On the cusp of the competitive national college entrance exams, Nian, a 17-year-old schoolgirl becomes the target of school bullying after a fellow classmate committed suicide. She later discovers an unlikely ally in Bei, an orphaned street youth. He becomes her protector and they form a unique bond that is soon tested when they are both implicated in a murder.

programme.title: The Rising Star -Renci Yeung / 我要做接班人 -楊偲泳
programme.desc: How did a late-night street shoot ignite Renci Yeung's dream of becoming an actress? Describing herself as a blend of conflicting rational and emotional sides, she found an outlet for her emotions through acting. How does she calmly face scrutiny and criticism from the public when taking on daring roles? Ten years into her career, this rising talent keeps cherishing every hard-won opportunity and moving forward with a free-spirited attitude and the same initial thrill for acting that first ignited her passion.

programme.title: Life is Beautiful / 給自己的情歌
programme.desc: Suddenly learning she is terminally ill, 'Se-yeon' asks her husband, 'Jin-bong', the absurd task of helping her find her first love, and he unwillingly joins her search. Along their journey, 'Se-yeon' and 'Jin-bong' are reminded of the most glittering, beautiful moments of their lives.

programme.title: The Monkey King / 西遊記之大鬧天宮
programme.desc: Since the beginning of time, there existed in the world three clans; human, god and demon. As everything was destroyed during the great battle, Nuwa (Goddess of Works) used 36,500 magic boulders to repair Heaven. One of them fell accidentally down onto Earth and landed on the Mountain of Flowers and Fruits on an island far across the Eastern Sea. Over thousands of years, the magic boulder absorbed the energies of Heaven and Earth and the sacred lights of the Sun and Moon. A godly creature was nurtured inside the stone-egg and a full-grown monkey burst out from it one day. When the Patriarch Subodhi passed by on his way to collect herbs in the Mountain, he came upon the monkey. Impressed by his exceptional wit and godly he took the monkey back to the Divine Cave of Three Stars in Mountain Mi to teach him the Way and called him Sun Wukong...

programme.title: Baogu At the Movie E288 -Cold War 1994 / 爆谷電影現場 第288集 -寒戰 1994
programme.desc: Baogu At The Movie brings you the most exclusive behind the scenes of recent local blockbusters. The most true story and sincere conversation behind every piece of dreamwork.

programme.title: Grand Maison Paris / 摘星廚神．巴黎夢
programme.desc: After their restaurant 'Grand Maison Tokyo' earned a Michelin three-star, Natsuki Obana and Rinko Hayami venture to Paris to open 'Grand Maison Paris,' aiming to become the first Asian chefs to achieve the same honor. However, they face cultural challenges and intense pressure in a city filled with culinary masters. Following a mishap at a gala dinner, Obana makes a pact with his former mentor: he will leave France if they don't earn three stars in the next Michelin evaluation. Can Obana and his team overcome these obstacles to achieve their dream?

programme.title: Integrity / 廉政風雲 煙幕
programme.desc: The multi-year ICAC investigation into the Lida Conglomerate is on the brink of collapse after the CEO's disappearance and the whistleblower's fleeing to Australia. To salvage the case, a top ICAC agent teams with a fellow investigator (who happens to be his estranged wife) and risks their lives to bring the witness back to Hong Kong.

programme.title: Artisan spirit in films: Fagara / 匠心光影: 花椒之味
programme.desc: After her father died, a Hong Kong girl discovers she has two hitherto unknown sisters, one in Taipei and one in Chongqing. To settle her father's debt, she must reunite with them to run the family's hot pot restaurant. While the androgynous Taipei sister is plagued by her toxic relationship with her mother, the fashionista sister from Chongqing is trying to fend off her grandmother's pressure to get married. Meanwhile, she is striving to unshackle herself from her ex-boyfriend in order to start a new relationship.

programme.title: CRISIS NEGOTIATORS / 談判專家
programme.desc: Negotiator expert Cheuk Man Wai unexpectedly becomes the prime suspect in a murder case. Forced into a corner, he occupies the police station, taking officers hostage, and demands negotiations with the former negotiator Tse Ka Chun. With Tse's expertise in psychological manipulation and Cheuk's exceptional skills, they engage in a battle of wits. As the verbal sparring deepens, their positions and mindsets gradually change...This film is adapted from the American movie 'The Negotiator'.

programme.title: Unfinished Girl / 第三個人
programme.desc: He Wei and Xiao Feng are a perfect couple. One day, her younger sister, Xiao Ke, discovers the man who murdered her parents is He Wei, and she invites him back to her home...

programme.title: The Medium / 凶靈祭
programme.desc: A horrifying story of a shaman's inheritance in the Isan region of Thailand. What could be possessing a family member might not be the Goddess they make it out to be. A documentary team follows Nim, a shaman based in Northern Thai, the Isan area, and encounters her niece Mink showing strange symptoms that seem to be of inheritance of shamanism. The team decides to follow Mink, hoping to capture the shaman lineage passing on to the next generation, but her bizarre behavior becomes more extreme.

programme.title: Accident / 意外 (2009)
programme.desc: A self-styled “accident choreographer,” the Brain is a professional hitman who kills his victims by trapping them in well crafted “accidents” that look like unfortunate mishaps but are in fact perfectly staged acts of crime. Perennially plagued with guilt, he is also suspicious and morbid by nature. The recent avalanche of memories of his lost wife does not make things any easier. After one mission accidentally goes wrong, causing the life of one of his men, the Brain is convinced that this accident has been choreographed: someone is out there plotting to terminate him and his team. He becomes increasingly paranoid, walking on the thin line between reality and delusion...

programme.title: Love On A Diet / 瘦身男女
programme.desc: Mini Mo becomes a fatty when her boyfriend went abroad ten years ago. She meets Fatso in the time of adversity. When Fatso learns the true story behind Mini's depression...

programme.title: Let’s Go Karaoke! / 唱K吧！黑道之哥
programme.desc: Yakuza member Narita is consumed by only one thing: how to survive his boss' annual karaoke competition. Desperate to avoid his boss' cruel and unusual punishment for losing, Narita recruits junior high school choir member Oka to teach him how to sing. The trouble is, Narita is impossibly hopeless as a singer. The stakes may be low, but Yamashita Nobuhiro's deadpan approach to an unlikely friendship and Ayano Go's hilariously self-deprecating performance make this a winning comedy that will inspire you to hit the karaoke box. Rarely has the butchering beloved pop classics ever been funnier.

programme.title: Dot 2 Dot / 點對點
programme.desc: Chung returns from Canada to a drastically transformed Hong Kong and hoping to capture the city in his childhood years, graffitis a cryptic diagram near every subway station, in the form of dot-to-dot games. Soon they are discovered by Xue, a Putonghua teacher from Changchun determined to solve these riddles as she immerses herself in our city's culture and history...

programme.title: I Love You, You're Perfect, Now Change! / 你咪理，我愛你！
programme.desc: I Love You, You're Perfect, Now Change! is a musical comedy with a twist of Hong Kong sentiment, adapted from the hugely popular Broadway Musical of the same title. The original musical premiered Off-Broadway in 1996, and has been running for 23 years. The Hong Kong-based Windmill Grass Theatre adapted the musical and premiered in Hong Kong in 2005. The show had its fifth run in 2017 and had sold out each time. This movie version features 12 vignettes. An ensemble cast of over 60 well-known Hong Kong actors, singers and dancers will be performing multiple hilarious musical numbers that explore one central theme in life – love.

programme.title: Stars in Focus: Gigi Leung: Driving Miss Wealthy / 爆谷巨星匯：梁詠琪: 絕世好賓
programme.desc: A man is hired to look after a spoiled rich girl, but is then pulled into a scheme meant to re-evaluate her life.

programme.title: Baogu Produces -The Frontline of Cold War / 爆谷製造 -寒戰前哨站
programme.desc: The long-awaited “Cold War” series returns! Director Longman Leung together with Terrance Lau and Louise Wong disclose the untold stories of filming “Cold War 1994”. While Terrance reveals filming car chase scenes had been his brush with death, Louise confesses to being stressed to play the role of a gang boss for the first time that took her three months of preparation for the action scenes. Longman also shares about the tycoon kidnapping case in the film inspired by real cases from the 1990s......

programme.title: Galaxy Writer / 銀河寫手
programme.desc: A group of young people dreaming of becoming directors, screenwriters, actors, producers, and more. Among them were two screenwriters, Zhang Liaoyi and Sun Tan. They wrote a movie script that they believed would go down in history and were determined to bring it to the big screen.

programme.title: Table for Six (Extended version) / 飯戲攻心 (加長版)
programme.desc: It is often said that food and meals bring families together, but in TABLE FOR SIX it's clear that not all family gatherings are a cause for celebration. In this melodramatic comedy, three brothers reside in a home that they inherited from their late parents. The eldest brother Steve (Dayo Wong), theoretically is the man of the house, but he constantly is getting dissed by his two younger brothers Bernard (Louis Cheung Kai Chung) and Lung (Chan Charm Man Peter) for the decisions he makes, the inedible meals that he cooks, and his complicated romantic encounters. To prepare for a family reunion dinner, Steve seeks the help of Lung's girlfriend and foodie Josephine (Ivana Wong) and in doing so, wins back their hearts for a while, until his old flame and Bernard's new girlfriend Monica (Stephy Tang) shows up. That's a recipe for a disaster waiting to explode! The unexpected visit of Steve's part-time girlfriend Meow (Lin Min-Chen) not only fails to turn down the heat and cool th

programme.title: Goddamned Asura / 該死的阿修羅
programme.desc: During the night of his 18th birthday, Jan-Wen committed a random shooting homicide in the crowed night-market, with his self-made modified gun and for some mysterious reasons. The tragic incident caused the life of his family and friends, the victims, and the witnesses all facing the tremendous impact in the aftermath. However, what if there was a chance for these people to make different choices, will the tragedy remain? Will it be a brand new outcome if they all altered their behavior at the crucial moment?

programme.title: Exclusive Premiere: KOKUHO / 爆谷獨家首播：匠心光影: 國寶
programme.desc: In 1960s Nagasaki, after the death of his yakuza father, gifted teenager Kikuo is taken under the wing of famed Kabuki actor Hanjiro Hanai, even though the great performer already has a son, Shunsuke, who has dedicated his life to the art. Over fifty years, the relationship of the two disciples entwines and twists, and their hearts suffer as much yearning, glory and downfall as their on-stage alter-egos.

programme.title: Election / 黑社會
programme.desc: The time has come, as it does every two years, for the senior members of Hong Kong's oldest Triad, The Wo Shing Society, to elect a new chairman. Fierce rivalries emerge between the two eligible candidates. Lok, respected by the Uncles is the favorite to win. But his rival Big D will stop at nothing to change this, including going against hundreds of years of Triad tradition and influencing the vote with money and violence.

programme.title: Election 2 / 黑社會2以和為貴
programme.desc: In post-1997 Hong Kong, even the long-established “Wo Shing” Triad Society has to succumb to the upper power. The entrepreneurial sect leader Jimmy (Louis Koo) seems to be the perfect candidate to lead the Society into the new Millennium. Only problem is, Jimmy wants out...

programme.title: Baogu At the Movie E279 -Cold War 1994 / 爆谷電影現場 第279集 -寒戰 1994
programme.desc: Baogu At The Movie brings you the most exclusive behind the scenes of recent local blockbusters. The most true story and sincere conversation behind every piece of dreamwork.

programme.title: Still Missing / 兒蹤
programme.desc: April is a beloved 8-year-old daughter of Pij and Ake. Unfortunately, she is kidnapped mysteriously and Pij dedicates her life to finding her missing daughter. One day there is a burnt corpse of a girl and the only thing left is a small piece of fabric that matches April's cloth on the day she disappeared. The DNA result from the fabric proves that it matches 95% of April's DNA. Pij doesn't believe that it is April's corpse and continues searching for her daughter. Pij hires Tan, who used to work for a Missing Children Foundation. Pij has hope again until they meet a psycho man who brutally kidnaps children. The life-threatening struggle to find the truth; therefore, begins...

programme.title: Exodus / 出埃及記
programme.desc: Tsim Kin Yip has been an ordinary beat cop for more than two decades, failing all the promotion interviews he's tried over the years. One afternoon, Tsim is on duty in the report room. Kwan Ping Man, a suspect accused of peeping in a women's washroom, is giving a statement. Tsim heard the big secret from Kwan there's a global women's organization plotting to kill all the men in the world. Tsim finds the story ridiculous but no choice but to write down what he's told. That night, Kwan's statement has gone missing. He returns to the station to take another report, but this time Kwan has switched his story and pleads guilty. It seems he has something to hide. Tsim's suspicions are aroused and he decides to do some investigating...

programme.title: Fist Of Stardom / 拳霸無銀用
programme.desc: Thongpoon wants to produce a movie by using his gift of martial art to be a leading actor. Without money, he joins a boxing gambling for finding funds, but at last he becomes a prizefighter unexpectedly.

programme.title: Baogu Produces -Vicious Men and Wicked Women / 爆谷製造 -狠男惡女
programme.desc: The cast of “We Are Born Good”, Yeung Wai Lun, Chung Suet Ying, and Kearen Pang, together with Director Yeung Leung Chuen, join us to discuss their lives as 'unconventional' individuals! In the interview, Suet Ying recalled that she was once harassed, prompting her to strike back by posting a public note; Wai Lun admitted that he used to fear the heavy responsibility of carrying a film as a lead actor; and Kearen shares how she once faced a 'curse' that made it difficult for her to land acting roles. Meanwhile, Leung Chuen offers warm encouragement, urging everyone to discover the small, beautiful things in life and regain their motivation! Tune in as the four of them personally unveil more surprising behind-the-scenes stories from the film.

programme.title: Midnight Sun / 因你而在午夜閃耀
programme.desc: Misol, who has a rare condition that prevents her from being exposed to sunlight, has long given up on both dreams and love. One day, she falls in love at first sight with Minjun, the 'fruit truck guy' who shows up in front of her house. To see him again, Misol eagerly counts down to sunset each day. Minjun, who's out selling fruit with determination each night, finds himself drawn to Misol, who only sings under the cover of darkness. Captivated by her Cinderella-like charm, Minjun soon begins to look forward to the night just as much. As the two grow closer, they begin to share their dreams and love... supporting one another as Misol pursues her path as a singer-songwriter, and Minjun takes on the challenge of becoming an actor...

programme.title: Good Times, Bed Times / 戀上你的床
programme.desc: Carrie left Raymond not because he had too many other women, but only because he slept with another woman right on the bed Carrie has always been obsessed with. After the break up, she begged for ownership of the bed she's gotten used to. Carrie was assigned to follow the story of city's celebrated super cop, Paul Ko. While exchanging fire he was shot at by an AK-47 and become a sexual impotent. During the process of interviewing, Carrie has fallen to Paul. Raymond is being considered for a promotion to district court, his superiors request for him to stay away from the night-life and women. In the thick of this difficult celibate period, an 18 year old girl called Tabby barges into Raymond's life...

programme.title: The Plot / 意外
programme.desc: Young-il is a plotter who manipulates murder-for-hire cases to look like accidents. Nobody knows those accidents are in fact perfectly plotted, planned murders. After finishing a flawlessly plotted case with no trace of evidence left behind, Young-il receives a new request. His new target is a prominent political figure who is always under the spotlight. Even with the higher risk of getting exposed, Young-il decides to take the case with his team members, Jackie, Wol-cheon, and Jeom-man. When the plot is ready after immaculate preparation and numerous rehearsals, the team finally makes its move, but some unexpected trouble threatens Young-il's perfect plan.

programme.title: What if SHOGUN Ieyasu Tokugawa was to become the Prime Minister / 如果德川家康成為總理大臣
programme.desc: In the year of 2020, when Covid-19 is spreading rapidly around the world, a sudden virus outbreak in Japan leads to the death of the Prime Minister. This causes the Japanese government to put in place an unprecedented plan, which is to bring back the greatest leaders from Japanese history through AI holograms and form a super cabinet with them. These famous individuals include Tokugawa Ieyasu, Sakamoto Ryoma, Oda Nobunaga, and Toyotomi Hideyoshi. On the other hand, a TV reporter, Risa Nishimura, approaches the government spokesperson, Sakamoto Ryoma, for an exclusive scoop, in order to achieve her dream of becoming an announcer. As people start going crazy over this new legendary cabinet, Risa realizes that something is going on behind this cabinet...

programme.title: Baogu At the Movie E285 -Cold War 1994 / 爆谷電影現場 第285集 -寒戰 1994
programme.desc: Baogu At The Movie brings you the most exclusive behind the scenes of recent local blockbusters. The most true story and sincere conversation behind every piece of dreamwork.

programme.title: Table For Six 2 / 飯戲攻心2
programme.desc: Belief in our own blessings can bring us good fortune, but what is true fortune? Fortune and misfortune, love and hate, what is their ultimate definitions? One family, three couples, three weddings. After they decided to move on, what further challenges await them? Marriage isn't just about two individuals; it involves a whole family of aunts, uncles, and cousins. Sunny Chan, with his unique sense of humor, once again dives into the complex dynamics of modern society's men and women, families and romance.

programme.title: Sinkhole / 危樓深淵
programme.desc: An ordinary office worker Dong-won (KIM Sung-kyun) and his family move into a house he bought after years of saving. Overwhelmed with happiness, he invites his colleagues to a housewarming party, but heavy overnight rain leads to a gigantic sinkhole, and in a mere minute, it swallows up the entire apartment and the people inside. Hundreds of meters down the hole, Dong-won, his neighbor Man-su (CHA Seoung-won), and the unfortunate housewarming party guests must find their way out. Rain starts to pour down, filling the sinkhole with water, giving them very little time to get back to the surface.

programme.title: Baby Blues / 詭嬰
programme.desc: When blogger Tian Qing and song-writer Hao married, Hao buys an old house, and Tian Qing likes a doll left by the previous owner. From then on, it's as if the doll is always watching the newly weds. Soon, Tian Qing is pregnant with twins. Very unusual since neither Hao nor Tian Qing have a history of twins in their family. But a homeless man who lives at the end of their road isn't happy for them, he even warns them to move out of the house as soon as possible. It's happy news that his wife is pregnant, plus his work is going well because a popular singer wants him to produce her next track. Hao is coming home late, sometimes staying overnight in the studio. So he asks Tian Qing's younger sister, Trinket, to come stay with them to look after his wife...

programme.title: Baogu At the Movie E299 -The Remnant / 爆谷電影現場 第299集 -惡人當道
programme.desc: Baogu At The Movie brings you the most exclusive behind the scenes of recent local blockbusters. The most true story and sincere conversation behind every piece of dreamwork.

programme.title: Initial D / 頭文字Ｄ
programme.desc: Takumi delivers tofu in father's old Toyota every day and unwittingly acquires difting skills. An unexpected victory awakens his competitive genes, leading him to fierce races.

programme.title: Wolf Hiding / 怒潮
programme.desc: Amid the transfer of power at the Hongtai Group, which wields influence in both the lawful and unlawful worlds, a mysterious assassin named Chen An suddenly enters this vortex of confusion and throws the Hongtai Group into chaos. Mai Longwen from the police and Ma Wenkang from the gangs both have their eyes on him... Various forces are waiting for the opportunity to strike. Who is the mastermind behind the scenes? A fierce battle is about to break out.

programme.title: In Search of Lost Time / 海的盡頭是草原
programme.desc: In the late 1950s, Du Siheng was sent to Shanghai Orphanage by her mother, who couldn't support two kids. Later, she was transferred to Inner Mongolia and adopted by a loving family. Sixty years later, Du Sihan set out for Inner Mongolia and embarked on a journey to find his elder sister. The journey, however, turned out to be full of twists and turns...... Du Siheng couldn't adapt to the life on the grassland when she first arrived in Inner Mongolia. Touched by the love and warmth from the Mongolia people, the young Du Siheng gradually integrated into her new family. After six decades, the sister and brother reunited again and finally let go of the past. They reminisced the days when their fathers fought for the land beneath their feet and drew motivation from the older generation to work hard for a more promising and prosperous future.

programme.title: Let it Ghost / 猛鬼3寶
programme.desc: This anthology film features a triplet of horror stories starring up-and-coming actors and popular local Youtubers. When a film crew is haunted by paranormal activities, the director decides to cast her to play a ghost; When a taxi driver takes his girlfriend to a party room to get it on, a horny ghost adds spice to the proceedings; When a wandering ghost refuses to leave a soon-to-be-gentrified mall, the tenants concoct a plan to send her off.

programme.title: Love My Scent / 脫單香氣神助攻
programme.desc: Chang-soo, a guy who has never been in a romantic relationship, earns a magical power after accidentally wearing a perfume he receives from a stranger. The supernatural power he earns is what any man would dream of, an ability to attract every woman in the world! Ara, a woman Chang-soo has been in love with, begins to sense the scent of Chang-soo and falls in love with him. While they gradually grow their connection, Ara's ex-boyfriend, James, suddenly appears and reveals Chang-soo's secret! Will the two people overcome this predicament and find true love in each other?

programme.title: The Moment / 此情此刻
programme.desc: 'The Moment' talks about four relationships - A couple breaking up yet holding tight; a father and a daughter meeting up after a long separation; a girl escaping from growing up; and two buddies' reunion after years of misunderstanding. Different people carry different stories. The stories are connected by a vintage photography studio holder. Their experiences bring out a variety of sensations to the city we are living in; these feelings belong to them, and also us.

programme.title: Exiled / 放‧逐
programme.desc: Two hit men from Hong Kong sent to take out a renegade member trying to turn over a new leaf with his wife and newborn baby. They soon find themselves in the throes of a dilemma when two of their former associates also show up, intent on thwarting them at every cost...

programme.title: Ne Zha / 哪吒之魔童降世
programme.desc: The aura from heaven and earth has given birth to a powerful pearl inserted with huge energy. Yuanshi Tianzun (the Primeval Lord of Heaven) concocts two pills out of the pearl – a spiritual pill (Ling Zhu) and a sorcery pill (Mo Wan). He then seals both of them in the seven-colored sacred lotus. The spiritual pill will reincarnate as a man, who is destined to assist in the creation of the new Zhou dynasty; whilst a demon will be born of the sorcery pill, who is set to bring great destructions to the world. To prevent disasters, Yuanshi Tianzun has initiated a kalpa spell to strike the sorcery pill with thunder in three years. Facing the advent of the thunder, will Nezha still be the demon as destined? What will he choose?

programme.title: Fly Me to The Saitama – FROM BIWA LAKE WITH LOVE / 飛翔吧﹗埼玉2
programme.desc: A live-action film adaptation of Mineo Maya's “Fly Me to the Saitama” turned out to be a huge, unexpected box office hit of 2019. With the producers who took the demand for a sequel as real, the cast and crew got back together to complete the second chapter of the urban legend in Fly Me To The Saitama -FROM BIWA LAKE WITH LOVE-. In addition to the biting yet affectionate dissing of Saitama and the Kanto region in the first film, the sequel contains an even more scathing dissing of the Kansai region. Alongside costars GACKT and Fumi Nikaido, Ryo Kato and Tsubasa Masuwaka reprise their roles as members of the Saitama Liberation Front. A crucial protagonist who joins their battle, Kai Kikyo, the handsome leader of the Shiga Liberation Front, is played by Anne in her first role as male character. Akira Kashoji, the ruthless governor of Osaka and kingpin of the Kansai region who stands in the way of Rei and others, is played by Ainosuke Kataoka. In addition to Norika Fujiwara and

programme.title: The Battle at Lake Changjin / 長津湖
programme.desc: The story takes place in winter, 1950. In the freezing cold Changjin Lake region, a bloody battle between the United States and China begins. Faced with the harshest conditions of extreme cold, lack of rations and vast difference in weaponry, the Chinese troops forge ahead, fearless and determined. They successfully blow up the Shuimen Bridge, making the most critical victory in the War to Resist U.S. Aggression and Aid Korea.

programme.title: Breaking News / 大事件
programme.desc: A TV news unit live broadcasts the embarrassing defeat of a police battalion by five bank robbers. Later, Inspector Rebecca decides to turn the stakeout into a breaking news show.

programme.title: Baogu At the Movie E288 -Cold War 1994 / 爆谷電影現場 第288集 -寒戰 1994
programme.desc: Baogu At The Movie brings you the most exclusive behind the scenes of recent local blockbusters. The most true story and sincere conversation behind every piece of dreamwork.

programme.title: Baogu Produces -Vicious Men and Wicked Women / 爆谷製造 -狠男惡女
programme.desc: The cast of “We Are Born Good”, Yeung Wai Lun, Chung Suet Ying, and Kearen Pang, together with Director Yeung Leung Chuen, join us to discuss their lives as 'unconventional' individuals! In the interview, Suet Ying recalled that she was once harassed, prompting her to strike back by posting a public note; Wai Lun admitted that he used to fear the heavy responsibility of carrying a film as a lead actor; and Kearen shares how she once faced a 'curse' that made it difficult for her to land acting roles. Meanwhile, Leung Chuen offers warm encouragement, urging everyone to discover the small, beautiful things in life and regain their motivation! Tune in as the four of them personally unveil more surprising behind-the-scenes stories from the film.

programme.title: Little Q / 小Q
programme.desc: A story about the life of the guide dog Quill: the love interaction between Little Q and the puppy raiser, the guide dog trainer and the newly blind dessert chef Lee Po Ting - how it earns the trust of Po Ting and makes Po Ting take a new lease of life.

programme.title: Baogu Produces -Deconstructing the Cold War Universe / 爆谷製造 -拆解寒戰宇宙
programme.desc: Director Longman Leung is here to shed light on the mysteries of the “Cold War” series. What actually does the operation codename “Cold War” mean? Longman reveals that not a single shot had been fired in the first script while the foreshadowing in dialogue of 'Cold War' and 'Cold War 2' are going to be revealed in the sequel! Let's find out more behind-the-scenes stories of the “Cold War” series shared by Longman.

programme.title: SANA / 錄陰帶
programme.desc: You, too, will find yourself humming the melody. It all started with a cassette tape. Sana is a mysterious middle school girl who collects “the sound of soul.” Everyone who hears the melody gets possessed and starts to hum it themselves. At the end of the cursed melody's chain of infections lies an unexpected terror waiting to strike. Just what is Sana after?! Once you hum this melody, it will be your undoing.“Did you get the cassette tape?”

programme.title: Cesium Fallout (Extended version) / 焚城 (加長版)
programme.desc: After a fire accident triggers a radiation leakage, the entire city suddenly finds its survival hanging by a thread. In order to tackle the impending catastrophe, expert Simon Fan joins the emergency crisis response team led by Acting Chief Executive Cecilia to tackle this catastrophic disaster. With the lives of 7 million people on the line, the fire brigade is tasked with stopping the spread at all costs by entering the radiation zone. Facing this unprecedented calamity, will Hong Kong wake up to an overnight annihilation?

programme.title: Making of Cesium Fallout / 焚城的誕生
programme.desc: Directed by Anthony Pun, 'Cesium Fallout' is the first Hong Kong's historic first radiation disaster blockbuster that has won 5 nominations at the 43rd Hong Kong Film Awards. This documentary has recorded every little bits of behind-the-scene as well as the sharing from Anthony Pun, the cast and the production crew.

programme.title: Full River Red / 滿江紅
programme.desc: During the Song Dynasty, set against a brewing rebellion by the Jin people against the Imperial Court.Two hours before a crucial diplomatic meeting between the Song Prime Minister Qin Hui and a high level Jin delegation, the Jin Ambassador is murdered. An important letter destined for the Emperor is stolen from him. As the search for the letter unfolds, alliances are formed, secrets are revealed, and no one can stop the truth that is destined to leave its mark in history.

programme.title: The Point Men / 24小時救參行動
programme.desc: A group of Korean tourists is taken hostage by an extremist Taliban group in Afghanistan. The Korean government dispatches Jae-ho, known as one of Korea's most skilled diplomats, in order to handle the situation. Once he arrives, he asks for the Afghan government's cooperation and uses every means possible to free the hostages. However, his efforts go in vain. Due to his failure, he's forced to work with Dae-sik, a special agent who is an expert on the Middle East. As they begin making their move to get to the Taliban, the first hostage death occurs. With nowhere else to turn, the two become unlikely allies in a race against time to save the rest of the hostages.

programme.title: My Lucky Star / 非常幸運
programme.desc: Going nowhere in love and stuck in life as a lowly travel agent, Sophie finds escape in her own comic book creations. When she was winning the office contest for a prize trip to Singapore suddenly turns her life upside in the best way possible, as she meets there the man of her dreams: David, the handsome super-spy from her own comics. Before she can even get pack her luggage together, off they jump from the Marina Bay Sands Skydeck, and the chase is on for a lip-shaped key to the billion-dollar diamond called “Lucky Star Diamond”, a diamond capable of destroying the world, one country at a time.

programme.title: Time / 殺出個黃昏
programme.desc: Last generation of assassins moved to HK in 50/60's and posted as “killer-for-hire' trio to fix all sort of problems for their clients. Decades passed, they now become redundant themselves at work and home. An accidental mission calls upon them turns out to be an assisted suicide. The trio suddenly finds new ‘life'.....as ”Guardian Angels of the Elders”. Just when they are finding meanings to this new role, an order from a teenager turns their new practice upside down again......this might as well be their very last job.

programme.title: First Gentleman / 總理之夫
programme.desc: Ornithologist (a scholar of birds) Hiyori Soma is married to Rinko, leader of a minority political party. One morning, his beloved wife poses an enigmatic question. “Hey, Hiyori, would you have a problem if I became Prime Minister?” He asks her to repeat the question, but she shrugs him off. Still confused, he sets off for a ten-day expedition on a remote island with no cell phone connection to observe birds in the wild. In his absence, Rinko changes the future of the nation! She is elected the first female Prime Minister in Japan's history, making Hiyori the first ever Prime Minister's husband. He was always 100% supportive of Rinko's political ambitions, but could never have imagined the life that awaited him...

programme.title: My First Of May / 無名指
programme.desc: My First of May follows TANG Suk Yin and his daughter TANG Chi, whose lives are turned upside down when Chi is diagnosed with a serious illness, given little chance to survive past two. Faced with this heart-wrenching reality, Suk Yin and his wife, Elaine YEUNG, promise to cherish every moment with Chi. Miraculously, Chi survives beyond two, but this brings significant changes. The couple sacrifices their dreams to care for her-Suk Yin gives up his squash career, while Elaine, overwhelmed by pressure, abandons the family. In despair, Suk Yin withdraws and becomes a recluse. Without parental support, Chi relies on her grandmother, SUEN Yau Mui. When her grandmother's health deteriorates, Suk Yin can no longer ignore his responsibilities and returns home. After years apart, how will they mend their strained relationships? Unexpectedly, a small understanding from the past helps them reconnect. With Suk Yin's support, Chi gains movement in her ring finger, rekindling love in the

programme.title: Men of Plastic / 肌智整容大叔
programme.desc: The most glamorous part of Seoul, Apgujeong thrives with new possibilities. Dae-guk who is a native of Apgujeong and rules its ground, is eager to start his own groundbreaking plastic surgery business. Then he encounters Ji-woo, the most talented surgeon in the area who lost his medical license due to someone sabotaging his reputation. Dae-guk effortlessly comes up with an idea to make this business happen, and he does everything he can to make Ji-woo his partner. Together, Dae-guk and Ji-woo open a whole new era of Apgujeong.

programme.title: The Uniform / 夜校女生
programme.desc: Set in 1997's Banqiao, the story explores the struggles and brilliance of a girl named Xiao Ai as she navigates her journey of growth. Originally accepted into her dream high school, Xiao Ai is compelled by her mother to transfer to the night school at Taipei First Girls' High School. Sharing desks with day students during the day, she forms a deep friendship with her 'desk mate,' Min Min. However, feeling inferior because of her identity as a night school student, she and Min Min both develop feelings for the gifted student, Luke. To conceal the truth, she dons the day school uniform and pretends to be the 'perfect girl' who matches Luke. The green uniform gives her confidence, but it also causes her lies to spiral out of control. On the day of the joint entrance exam, the truth is revealed, and Xiao Ai faces a heart-wrenching trial of growth amidst the storms of friendship, love, and family...

programme.title: Baogu At the Movie E299 -The Remnant / 爆谷電影現場 第299集 -惡人當道
programme.desc: Baogu At The Movie brings you the most exclusive behind the scenes of recent local blockbusters. The most true story and sincere conversation behind every piece of dreamwork.

programme.title: Along With The Gods: The Last 49 Days / 與神同行：終極審判
programme.desc: Su-hong and his 3 Afterlife Guardians journey through 7 hells in order for all them to be reincarnated, while a household god defies all rules to help ordinary people in the living world. And the afterlife guardian's tragic lives on earth thousand years ago are uncovered one by one during their battle against the god in human world.

programme.title: Don't Go Breaking My Heart / 單身男女
programme.desc: Yen is a single girl from mainland working in an IT company in Hong Kong. Overwhelmed by the hustle and bustle of this sleepless city, she feels increasingly like a fish out of water. Until she meets a handsome hunk, Sean and an elite architect, Kevin. Yen is no longer alone and lonely, but will she be able to find her true love?

programme.title: Turning Point / Laughing Gor之變節
programme.desc: Brother Laughing is supposedly an undercover police officer who has infiltrated a triad organization. During a drug-trafficking operation he is caused by Superintendent Poon. Before he became a police officer, Brother Laughing was a member of the triads and worked for the big boss man No. 1. No. 1 was very good to Laughing, and Laughing looked up to No. 1 as his elder brother. In order to strengthen his business and illegal activities, No. 1 arranges for Laughing to join the Police Force and become his mole to gather information about the plans and counter-plans for operations by the police. Laughing graduated from Police Academy with outstanding results but before he was assigned to a post as a police officer, his “bad boy” image attracted the attention of the Head of District Anti-Triad Squad, Superintendent Sin who arranges his assignment as an undercover cop to infiltrate the mob syndicate. Laughing was now a “double” mole. No. 1 was happy with this turn of events as Laug

programme.title: My Missing Valentine (a.k.a One Second Ahead, One Second Behind) / 快一秒的他
programme.desc: Hajime is a handsome young man, who is always a second quicker than everyone else. He works at the post office, where Reika comes to buy a stamp every day. Reika is a young woman, who is always a second slower than everyone else. On the day after Valentine's Day, Hajime wakes up to find himself losing all his memories from the previous day... A remake of the Best Film Winner at the Taipei Golden Horse Awards, My Missing Valentine, and relocating the story to Kyoto, the film tells a quirky romance caught in unexpected time differences.

programme.title: A Beautiful Moment / 我的情敵女婿
programme.desc: An ageing bachelor playboy finally meets the girl of his dreams and proposes marriage, only to discover her psychologist stepmom was his first love long ago. The future in-laws initially pretend not to know each other but as the wedding date gets nearer, the rekindling of long-dormant feelings develops into a cross-generational love triangle.

programme.title: Baogu Produces -Escape from the Windy Town / 爆谷製造 -逃出大風鎮
programme.desc: In the film “Trapped”, border town Mangya was taken over by a group of bandits where only three police officers with one pistol stationed. How could they bring all 44 bandits to justice? First-time director Zhang Qi reveals the inspirations and ideas behind in particular the story of notorious four criminals from the Mainland and Hong Kong's “King of Robbery” Yip Kai Foon while also tells more about his creative motive for several scenes of violence on screen.

programme.title: Trapped / 大風殺
programme.desc: The year is 1995. Mangya, a northwestern border town has become a ghost town since the once-prosperous mine and border trades shut down. The town has become an island, isolated from the outside world. There is only one police station with three police officers and one gun. XIA Ran, a retired soldier has spent over a decade here. There's a saying that he's the last survivor of the battlefield but he never talk about his story. Sandstorms hit the town once a year, and a catastrophic, once-in-decade sandstorm is forecasted for this year. The storm looms on the horizon; the final transport out of town has long left. In the dead of night, five corpses are tossed into the oil tank in the town's sole gas station. The piercing silence is interrupted by a pack of uninvited guests. However, what frightens XIA Ran more than the murders is that the gas station's tank has been emptied and the town's phone line has been severed. As the sandstorm closes in on Mangya, he realizes that everyo

programme.title: Beyond The Sin / 惡行之外
programme.desc: One rainy night, the dead body of a girl, the only daughter of Hong Kong police Yin Lok, is found in the wild. Polices based on clues, suspect has been identified. However, several more girls are murdered and murder cases keep happening. Yin begins to investigate his daughter's death and met a mentally retarded girls, he is looking for more clues from this special girl. Finally, Yin is getting closer to the truth...

programme.title: MY WORST NEIGHBOR / 隔牆有愛
programme.desc: Flirting with a wall between them! Seung-jin wants to become a singer, so he's preparing for a TV audition program. It's his first night at his new place. He suddenly hears a woman's ghostly wails! It turns out that Seung-jin's next door neighbor, Ra-ni has been driving people away from this apartment because of the super-thin walls! But Seung-jin won't go without a fight! After a battle of loud noises, they decide to take turns being noisy. They don't know each other's names or faces. But as they share their lives, they start to develop strange feelings for each other... The thin walls force them to share everything with each other. It's a brand new kind of romance!

programme.title: Baogu Produces -The Silent Arena / 爆谷製造 -聽不見的擂台
programme.desc: Sho Miyake, the Japanese director of Small, Slow but Steady, has showed up in Hong Kong to promote and present this ‘hushed' boxing film to the audience face-to-face. What is the meaning within his film? And how he made use of sound arrangements in order to allow audience experience a world like the main character of hearing-impaired does? In this episode, he will also reveal his reason of using 16mm film so that had repetitive takes avoided by actor in this work.

programme.title: Small, Slow but Steady / 惠子的凝視
programme.desc: Despite battling lifelong deafness, Keiko has managed to turn pro and obtain a winning record. But as her mentor faces health issues and her gym faces imminent closure due to the pandemic, Keiko finds her will to keep fighting starting to wane.

programme.title: Cat & Mouse / 老鼠愛上貓
programme.desc: Based on the popular Chinese novel Qi Xia Wu Yi about the story of Judge Pao in the Song Dynasty and his group of heroic helpers, who together solve cases and catch criminals galore. In the original story, Zhan Zhao is constantly at loggerheads with Bai Yutong, a Robin Hood figure who assists Judge Pao from the other side of the law. Their conflict experiences a modern rendition in this hilariously iconoclastic film.

programme.title: Baogu At the Movie E287 -Cold War 1994 / 爆谷電影現場 第287集 -寒戰 1994
programme.desc: Baogu At The Movie brings you the most exclusive behind the scenes of recent local blockbusters. The most true story and sincere conversation behind every piece of dreamwork.

programme.title: Broker / 孩子轉運站
programme.desc: 'Sanghyeon' is always struggling from debt, and 'Dongsu' works at a baby box facility. On a rainy night, they steal the baby 'Woosung,' who was left in the baby box, to sell him at a good price. Meanwhile, detectives were watching, and they quietly track them down to capture the crucial evidence.

programme.title: Tonkatsu DJ Agetaro / 炸豬排DJ揚太郎
programme.desc: Agetaro is the heir to his family's long-running tonkatsu (fried pork cutlet) restaurant in Shibuya, Tokyo. He spends his days chopping cabbages and slacking off because he has nothing else better to do. One day, he goes to a dance club to deliver a bento, and is thrilled to get a chance to speak to Sonoko, the girl he secretly has a crush on. He also experiences the excitement of the dance floor grooving to the music for the first time, and is filled with an uplifting sensation that he has never felt before. To win Sonoko's heart, Agetaro decides to become the “Tonkatsu DJ”, a guy who can cook both tonkatsu and the dance floor!

programme.title: Baogu At the Movie E285 -Cold War 1994 / 爆谷電影現場 第285集 -寒戰 1994
programme.desc: Baogu At The Movie brings you the most exclusive behind the scenes of recent local blockbusters. The most true story and sincere conversation behind every piece of dreamwork.

programme.title: Night King / 夜王
programme.desc: The year is 2012. The once-glamourous Club EJ suddenly experiences a hostile takeover. Much like the nightclub industry, the glory days are over for the club's manager, Foon, despite having stood tall in East Tsim Sha Tsui for decades. To make things worse for Foon, the club's new CEO is none other than his cutthroat ex-wife, Madame V! Determined to change things up, she leaves Foon and his hostesses with no choice but to transform and modernize in order to breathe new life into their business. Little do they know, a powerful conglomerate has been pulling the strings all along to shut down Club EJ for good. To save their neon empire, Foon and V must join forces and make an epic last stand with the hostesses against what seems to be inevitable doom.

programme.title: Don't Go Breaking My Heart 2 / 單身男女2
programme.desc: After the “Earthling” Cheung ShenRen loses Cheng Zixin to the “Martian” Fang Qihong, he decides to keep it cool and reverts to singlehood graciously. Cheng and Fang, meanwhile, live happily ever after. After jilted by Cheng, Cheung starts dating “Goddess of Stocks” Yang YangYang, who works in an opposite building. Yang has been turning a blind eye to Cheung's philandering until she meets Paul, a romantic returnee from France whose devotion has melted her heart....

programme.title: Revolver / 左輪殺姬
programme.desc: 'I'm getting the money I'm owed, why should I prepare myself? ”Su-young, a police officer waiting to move into her dream apartment, gets entangled in an unexpected corruption case. She accepts an offer to take all the blame in exchange for a large reward. Two years later, on the day of her release from prison, the only person who comes to see her is Yoon-sun, a woman she has never met before. Su-young senses that something has gone wrong. Determined to regain everything she has lost, Su-young sets out to find Andy, who promised her the reward, but she soon encounters an even bigger and more dangerous force behind him...

programme.title: Turning Point 2 / Laughing Gor之潛罪犯
programme.desc: To undertake the ending of TV drama “Lives of Omission”, Laughing is sentenced to life-imprisonment for killing Michael. In the prison, Laughing got to know Professor Fok, an introvert serving his sentence for drug-dealing. Professor Fok is a gifted psychologist who reads mind: discovering the deepest, darkest secrets of others, thus enabling him to manipulate and control others. Laughing learns more of psychology and he holds a strong admiration for Professor Fok. But in fact, Professor Fok has an ulterior motive. Laughing, confirming his imprisonment is all part of a new secret mission, the Security Bureau wants Laughing to infiltrate in prison to investigate further for the suspected corrupted cops...

programme.title: Virus / 戀愛病毒
programme.desc: The world is under attack from an “Love virus”? Taek-seon is a translator who always feels tired, unmotivated and uninterested in romance. One day, Taek-seon has a disastrous blind date with Su-pil, a born single medical researcher who proposes on their first meeting. After the date they met, the world is suddenly enveloped in atmosphere of love... Taek-seon found herself laughing for no reason and searching for a beautiful dress, everything looks cute, even a daily promotional text from her old classmate Yeon-woo. However, Taek-seon knew that she had been infected with 100% fatality rate deadly virus -- Toxo Virus. She meets Dr. Lee Gyun, the only researcher who can create the antiviral medicine and she realizes that all these romantic feelings are symptoms of virus. Thus, her unexpected journey begins...

programme.title: Why me, Sweetie?! / 失憶界刂女王
programme.desc: Ding studies drama in Beijing. One day, she helps her friend chase after her boyfriend, running vigorously on a Beijing street where she bumps into Dong. The next day, Ding visits Dong, who, strangely enough, denies their acquaintance. Dong's buddy Dr Ching diagnoses his erratic behavior as the protection mechanism of human brain. The only way to lessen the pain is to erase or repress happy memories...

programme.title: Crayon Shinchan the Movie: Super-Hot! The Spicy Kasukabe Dancers / 蠟筆小新劇場版：超華麗！灼熱的春日部舞者
programme.desc: To commemorate the sister city relationship between Kasukabe and Mushibai Hagashimiru in India, the 'Kasukabe Children's Carnival' was held. Word spread that winning the carnival's dance competition would earn a trip to India. Shin-chan, alongside with his trusty Kasukabe friends lit up the stage with a spectacular performance, clinching the championship and setting off for the curry-scented and starlit wonders of India! But little did they know, a thrilling adventure had beguan. During their India journey, Shin-chan and Bo-chan wandered into a shady general store and bought a peculiar nose-shaped backpack, unaware of its dark secret. Disaster struck when Bo-chan accidentally stuffed a mysterious slip of paper from the backpack in his nose, unleashing an evil force that transformed him into “Tyrant” Bo-chan, a rampaging villain with the power to destroy the world! With Bo-chan's personality warped and his actions spiralling out of control, can Shin-chan and his friends harnes

programme.title: She’s Got No Name / 醬園弄．懸案
programme.desc: Set in a bustling alleyway during the Japanese occupation of Shanghai in the 1940s, the film centres on a wife, Zhan Zhou, who was being charged with the bloody dismemberment of her husband – a killing that seems impossible for her to have committed alone. The murder thrusts Zhan into the spotlight and the court of public opinion, forcing her towards a fate intertwined with that of her own country.

programme.title: Nocturnal / 殺人預言
programme.desc: One day, the dead body of Min-tae only brother Seok-tae was found, and Seok-tae ‘s wife Moon-young has disappeared. While searching for clues on this brother's death, Min-tae found that a novelist Ho-ryung also following the same trail and he discovered that the death of his brother was predicted in Ho-ryung's bestselling novel, ‘Nocturnal.' Min-tae was thrown into confusion and brother's gang and police also getting involved in the case. To find out the truth behind brother's death, Min-tae began a relentless and furious pursuit...

programme.title: Life Hotel / 來福大酒店
programme.desc: To raise funds for his father, Sanqing, who has faced social ostracism, goes undercover at the Life Hotel near the hospital, aiming to disrupt its operations and coerce owner Xiao Lin into agreeing to its demolition. However, as they spend time together, Sanqing forms bonds with the hotel's residents and learns of the guests' life stories. His internal conflict escalates, turning a simple undercover assignment into a matter of personal integrity. The hotel's destiny impacts not only its inhabitants but also Sanqing's longing for home. Yet, his indecision triggers a deeper crisis...

programme.title: Line Walker / 使徒行者
programme.desc: When undercover agent Ding receives an encrypted message from Blackjack, who claims to be an undercover agent that has lost contact with the police, she reports it to her superior officer Inspector Q, who immediately launches a mission to search for Blackjack. During the mission, Ding visits a casino where she discovers that the supposedly dead triad leader Foon-hei is surprisingly alive and kicking. Meanwhile, Inspector Q narrows down Blackjack's whereabouts when he learns of a finance group's involvement in a drug deal in Brazil. The deal involves company chairman Kwok Ming, his advisor Lam, Lam's right-hand man Shiu and Foon-hei, who is plotting a comeback to the crime world. When the players learn of an undercover agent in their midst, paranoia and distrust begin to cloud over the deal...

programme.title: Project Silence / 末日廝殺橋
programme.desc: Due to sudden deteriorating weather conditions, visibility on the Airport Bridge is severely impaired, leaving people stranded and at risk of the bridge collapsing due to a series of chain collisions and explosions. Amidst the chaos, the canine subjects 'Echo' from the military experiment 'Project Silence,' who were being transported in secret, break free, and all human survivors become targets of relentless attacks. Various individuals find themselves stranded on the Airport Bridge for different reasons - a government official from the presidential office who was seeing off his daughter at the airport; a tow truck driver who was on his way to a multi-collision scene; an elderly who were returning from a trip abroad; sisters who missed their flights, and Dr. Yang, the researcher responsible for Project Silence - and a desperate struggle begins for them to escape to safety.

programme.title: Shin Ultraman / 新．超人
programme.desc: The continued appearance of giant unidentified life forms known as “S-Class Species (Kaiju)” has become commonplace in Japan. Conventional weapons have no effect on them. Having exhausted all other options, the Japanese Government issued the S-Class Species Suppression Protocol and formed an enforcement unit, known as the SSSP. The members chosen for the unit are: captain Kimio Tamura, strategic planner Shinji Kaminaga, unparticle physicist Akihisa Taki, and biologist Yumi Funaberi. In the midst of a Kaiju threat, a silver giant appears from beyond Earth's atmosphere. Analyst Hiroko Asami is newly appointed to the SSSP to deal with this giant and is partnered with Shinji Kaminaga. In Hiroko's report, she writes-“Ultraman, identity unknown.”

programme.title: The Narrow Road / 窄路微塵
programme.desc: Under this flashy city, amidst the numbness of frustrations, what people are looking forward to is the glimmer of light that might change their lives. Chak, who runs a small cleaning company, barely takes over the cleaning work on his own to make a living. Hitting by the COVID-19 pandemic, small business closed down one by one. One day, a young single mother, Candy, comes to look for a job opportunity from Chak. She doesn't seem like a trustworthy person to Chak, unexpectedly, she helps Chak to resolve many difficulties at work. Life seems like get back on track. The morning sun never lasts a day, Chak's company is being accused, at the same time, his family is facing a nightmare as well, all his hopes are dashed to pieces, but they can still try their best to resist the oppression of life and support each other through this painful year.

programme.title: Weeds on Fire / 點五步
programme.desc: In the year of 1984, 'Shatin Martins', the first Hong Kong youth baseball team, was formed. The 10 young players were living an uneasy and restless life as Hong Kong was being humiliated by one defeat after another and the fate of the 'Shatin Martins'...

programme.title: Hong Kong Family / 過時．過節
programme.desc: The chaos began at the Winter Solstice dinner eight years ago. The father lost his temper, the son, not able to forgive his father, ran away from home. Eight years have passed, and the family's relationship is still cold and distant. A cousin returns to Hong Kong from England and hopes to gather everyone for a Winter Solstice dinner. The long-awaited gathering prompted everyone to rethink their relationships with family members. Some choose to leave, some are back. When things are about to fall apart, it might as well be an opportunity to mend connections.

programme.title: Golden Chicken / 金雞
programme.desc: It is an exploration of one woman's wacky life of prostitution, spanning over 20 years in Hong Kong. Unattractive but happy-go-lucky and spunky, KUM is a true Hong Kong survivor.

programme.title: Blind Detective / 盲探
programme.desc: The crime-solver in the Police Crime Unit CHONG was forced to quit four years ago after he got blind accidentally and since then has worked as a private eye on cold cases to earn rewards for a living. He has spent nine months investigating the suspect for the Mongkok Acid Attack Case but was caught in a dire situation during an operation. Fortunately he was saved by a woman detective TUNG in the nick of time...

programme.title: Happy End / 快樂到死
programme.desc: Bora Choi, who works at an English language institute, is having an affair with her ex-lover, Il-Beom Kim. Her husband, Min-ki Seo, is a former banker. He has lost his job, and has taken over the domestic roles of the house: cooking, cleaning, and watching the baby. In his free time, he watches soap operas and reads romance novels. Min-ki is aware of the affair, but seems willing to put up with it and to continue living with his cheating wife. Bora is disturbed when Il-Beom seems to want to take their affair further and pushes past her boundaries, risking to expose their relationship.

programme.title: All You Need is Love / 總是有愛在隔離
programme.desc: On a quiet and peaceful afternoon, the Hong Kong Grande Hotel suddenly becomes the center of attention when it is suspected to be the epicenter of the coronavirus outbreak. The Center for Disease Control orders the hotel to be sealed, forcing its guests to undergo a mandatory 14-day quarantine. However, being isolated from the world ends up bringing the quarantined people together in unexpected ways. As they bond over this difficult time, they learn to treasure what may be their final moments together.

programme.title: All's Well End's Well 2020 / 家有囍事2020
programme.desc: The Yau's brothers are a trio of scammers who make punishing baddies their mission. A misunderstanding leads them to fellow con artists the Lui's sisters, and they join hands to scam a notorious mob boss. Through a myriad of ingenious tricks and disguises, they bring the mobster to justice as romance blossoms swiftly...

programme.title: Finding Mr. Right / 北京遇上西雅圖
programme.desc: Jiajia goes to Seattle to give birth to the son who's going to help her win over her rich, married boyfriend. But when the city nothing goes right...

programme.title: As It Burns / 白晝如焚
programme.desc: An explosion takes place in an apartment late at night, detective Ngai Wan arrives for the investigation and a charred woman body found on spot, her name is Yin Ching. Ching is getting married with Ng Lam who grew up in a wealthy family. Though it seems to be an accident, Wan feels that something is unusual. Wan first investigate the background of Ching and finds that her mother was died in a fire accident fifteen years ago also. Before that, Ching and her mother were in a difficult relationship, Lo Chi Fung was the only person Ching could talk to. They both grew up in Pak Sin Town and disappeared together after the accident happened. Wan perseveres in the investigation but the case just like falling into the mist as everyone related to Ching are all hiding some secrets. The turning point comes out until Lo Chi Fung and his girlfriend Lam Yam show up. The two fatal cases are crossing fifteen years, everyone can be suspected. The truth is far beyond everyone's imagination behi

programme.title: Good Deal / 人生轉運站
programme.desc: The great adventure stories of worn goods that build bridges between people from all walks of life, following a former baseball player, a sleepless student, a new hangman, an imprisoned gangster, and a mysterious father and daughter. Kwang-sung was once a rising baseball star but he is now a desperate man, cold, hungry, hunted by two hitmen. One day he receives a call from a little boy Jae-ha who asks him to sell his baseball jacket. Na-na is Jae-ha's English teacher who is trying to investigate a murder case that Kwang-sung must be involved. Ye-ji helps Kwang-sung's escape when she sells Min-hyuk a sleep-time controller. Her brother Soo-jung is a hangman who actually wants to be a rock star. Jae-ha's uncle Seok-ho visits a story hunter and his mysterious daughter to sell off his old bittersweet memories. When they are about to shake hands, Anna Karenina suddenly comes in. The lives of these seemingly unrelated people are woven together in a wildly entertaining and exciting c

programme.title: Three / 三人行
programme.desc: Zhau is a young doctor who desperately needs a successful operation on a high-profile patient to redeem a previous failure which not only cost the life of a patient but her self-esteem. Han is a suspect of multiple armed robberies and homicides, who has been taken to the hospital after being shot with a bullet in his head during a showdown with the police. Officer Lok is at first sight a gung-ho policeman who has participated in the showdown, but when he makes desperate attempts to do Han in by exploiting Zhau's weaknesses, it is apparent he is harboring a much darker secret...

programme.title: Dust to Dust / 第八個嫌疑人
programme.desc: In 1995, a large armed robbery occurred in Guangdong. A bank cash truck was robbed by five armed robbers, causing a loss of $15 million and three bank's escorts were killed. The incident shocked the whole country, the Police immediately set up a task force, led by Wang Shouyue and He Lan, and quickly found the whereabouts of the five robbers, except the real mastermind behind the case, the owner of a construction company, Chen Xinwen, and his cousin Chen Xinnian.Chen Xinwen and Chen Xinnian embarked on the road to escape, and has since evaporated. Twenty-one years later, the case has long faded from the public, and Wang Shouyue also retired. However, a usual video with a blurred figure rekindled his hope of solving the case...

programme.title: Back to the Past / 尋秦記
programme.desc: A wrongful imprisonment leads to a crisis that can change the course of history! To make up for his wrongful imprisonment, Ken vows to travel to the Qin dynasty and become the Qin Emperor. Meanwhile, in the Qin Dynasty, Hong Siu-lung and his family have spent the last two decades in seclusion, but his every move is still being watched by his disciple, the Qin Emperor. Just as the emperor is on the cusp of ultimate power after conquering the six rival warring states, he is ambushed by Ken and his team. With nowhere else to go, he turns to Hong, the mentor that he both reveres and fears, for safety, reuniting them for the first time in 20 years.
