programme.desc: Do rounds on the ranch that Albert the camel runs with his human friend Alex, then check in with Herbie the wallaby as he gets pampered by his pal Fleur. Cause a little chaos with Quincy the quoll and hang ten with Chupacabra the surfing goat.

programme.title: Pride Rules S1E3 -Hide and Seek / 獅群的法則 第3集 - 捉迷藏戲
programme.desc: Contend with the challenges of the rainy season, which turns everything green and spoils the lions’ camouflage. Watch Einstein fail to make new connections and weigh the pros and cons when Keeza and her cub are kidnapped by rival male Mad-Eye Moody.

programme.title: Europe's Wild Kingdoms S1E1 -Water Worlds / 歐洲野性王國 第1集 - 水之世界
programme.desc: Discover how Europe’s best architecture has created sanctuaries for some of the continent's rarest species. Journey to France, Scotland, and Spain, where seals, birds, newts, wildcats, and snakes thrive among ancient landmarks at the water’s edge.

programme.title: Europe's Wild Kingdoms S1E2 -Mountain Worlds / 歐洲野性王國 第2集 - 山之世界
programme.desc: Witness animal drama among Europe’s most dramatic peaks. Visit medieval castles in Romania and France where bears, lynx, and falcons are making a comeback, then check out a rock lizard that’s cleverly adapting to climate change in the Pyrenees.

programme.title: Wild Latin America S1E2 -Squirrel Monkey Island / 拉丁美生态奥秘 第2集 - 松鼠猴島
programme.desc: Travel deep into the Columbian rainforest, where it’s mating season for one of the most clever monkey species in the world. Witness the most important time of year for male squirrel monkeys that have been bulking up to impress females for months.

programme.title: Reef Wrecks S1E4 -Reef Wrecks of Roatan / 「礁」來船禍 第4集 - 羅丹島礁石沉船
programme.desc: This island of the coast of Honduras stands out as a vacation resort hot spot. But it’s not just the sun and sand that brings the tourists in droves. It’s actually a diver’s paradise with shipwrecks scattered from all corners of the the island.

programme.desc: Though Africa’s three big cats—the lion, leopard, and cheetah—live side by side, each has evolved a specialised set of hunting strategies that keep them from colliding. Take an in-depth look at the lives and stories of these iconic apex predators.

programme.title: Aussie Snake Wranglers: Deadly Pursuit S1E5 -Chasing Scales / 澳洲蛇類捕捉隊：死亡追捕 第5集 - 追逐鱗影
programme.desc: Storm into a new suburb, where the wranglers keep deadly snakes from slipping into family homes. Watch as Stu and Liv pull an eastern brown from a job site, Jess and Dan expel a python from a shed, and Mick and Adele evict a red belly from a bedroom.

programme.title: Life's Journey S1E2 -Life's Lessons / 生命之旅 第2集 - 生命的課題
programme.desc: If young animals survive until adulthood, the chances for survival are greatly increased - but many challenges face them before they can strike out on their own. Some have months to grow-up; other have decades – but all, have lots to learn along the way. From getting to grips with their bodies and learning to feed themselves, to practicing fighting skills and learning how to form friendships. There are many hurdles along the way, but every small success could mean the difference between life and death.

programme.title: Wild Castles S1E1 -Heidelberg / 壯麗的「堡」貝 第1集 - 海德堡
programme.desc: Explore beautiful Heidelberg Castle whose ruins stand in imposing wonder beside the river Neckar in Western Germany. Surrounded by a protected nature reserve, the castle is home to birds of prey and acts as a spawning ground for nearby amphibians.

programme.title: Wild Castles S1E2 -Carcassonne / 壯麗的「堡」貝 第2集 - 卡卡孫
programme.desc: Travel to a centuries-old French fortress, home to some of history's greatest empires. Carcassone, once a center of wealth and culture, is now a haven for wildlife. Birds, wild boar, and armies of insects endure in its bountiful surroundings.

programme.title: Wild Castles S1E3 -Predjama / 壯麗的「堡」貝 第3集 - 波賈馬
programme.desc: Discover the world's largest castle carved into a cave. Predjama, in Slovenia, has provided protection not only for its Medieval human inhabitants, but also serves as a haven for the birds, boars, and mountain goats that live in the region.

programme.title: Wild Castles S1E4 -Alhambra / 壯麗的「堡」貝 第4集 - 阿爾罕布拉宮
programme.desc: Tour the marvelous Alhambra, a must-see fortress in Spain's Grenada region. Today this world heritage site acts as a refuge for the region’s wildlife. With its many streams and fountains, Alhambra serves amphibian, fish, and bird alike.

programme.title: Wild Castles S1E5 -Neuschwanstein / 壯麗的「堡」貝 第5集 - 新天鵝堡
programme.desc: Learn how one of the world's most spectacular structures, Neuschwanstein castle, and its surrounding forests have become home base for many creatures. From the Alpine ibex to the majestic swans, this castle has been a natural haven for centuries.

programme.title: America's Wild Border: Northern Exposure / 美國野生邊界：北部揭祕
programme.desc: Trail Atlantic puffins, Prairie rattlesnakes, Alaskan caribou and other animals as they travel across the international boundary between the U.S. and Canada. See how they can move from safety to target by crossing a line they had no say in creating.

programme.title: Planet Shark S1E1 -Ultimate Predator / 鯊魚星球 第1集 - 終極獵手
programme.desc: Stalk the seas with sharks as they hunt using heightened senses and killer instincts. Watch a whitetip reef shark put its electrical sensors to work finding its prey’s heartbeat, and the pelagic thresher shark stun its quarry with its whiplike tail.

programme.title: Planet Shark S1E2 -Ocean Voyagers / 鯊魚星球 第2集 - 「鯊」海遨遊
programme.desc: Navigate the ocean’s vast distances, depths, and darkness with nomadic sharks that thrive in the blue emptiness. Meet a lone blue shark traversing stormy Atlantic seas, and hundreds of hammerheads returning to their Pacific island breeding ground.

programme.title: Planet Shark S1E3 -In the Extreme / 鯊魚星球 第3集 - 登峰造極
programme.desc: Follow a host of sharks with extraordinary abilities that allow them to thrive in the most adverse conditions around the globe. Observe nearly blind Greenland sharks made for life in freezing Arctic waters, and another species that can walk on land.

programme.title: Wild Latin America S1E1 -Humpback Birth of a Giant / 拉丁美生态奥秘 第1集 - 座頭鯨：巨物的誕生
programme.desc: Follow the first months of a newborn humpback whale’s life in the waters off the Pacific Coast of Columbia. See how his mother nurtures him through sickness, supports his body, protects him under attack, and prepares him for an epic journey.

programme.title: Wild Latin America S1E2 -Squirrel Monkey Island / 拉丁美生态奥秘 第2集 - 松鼠猴島
programme.desc: Travel deep into the Columbian rainforest, where it’s mating season for one of the most clever monkey species in the world. Witness the most important time of year for male squirrel monkeys that have been bulking up to impress females for months.

programme.title: Chasing the Rains S1E1 -The Fickle River / 逐雨之途 第1集 - 善變之河
programme.desc: Travel to Samburu, where matriarch Anastasia turns her elephant herd north after a local river dries up. Then, in Naboisho, see cheetah mom Kuleta evade a crafty pack of hyenas. Later, in Laikipia, check in on wild dog Phoenix and her new litter.

programme.title: Chasing the Rains S1E2 -Blood and Dust / 逐雨之途 第2集 - 血與塵
programme.desc: Discover the clever way elephants dig wells, and see the relief that comes with a sudden river-filling downpour. Mourn cheetah Kuleta’s loss after lions kill one of her cubs, and get a front-row seat when wild dog Phoenix faces off with a hyena mob.

programme.title: Big Cats: Nine Lives S1E1 -Lions / 大貓九命 第1集 - 獅子
programme.desc: Chart the lion’s nine stages of life, from defenseless cub to confident adult to aging exile. See how rivalry, hunger, and pride dynamics shape its life on the Serengeti, and witness the loyalty and cooperation that make this social cat unique.

programme.title: Big Cats: Nine Lives S1E2 -Tigers / 大貓九命 第2集 - 老虎
programme.desc: Navigate the forest with a tiny cub, watch young adults claim their territory, and witness the inevitable exile of aging hunters. Discover how instinct and stealth help the tiger survive in its solitary world, where every decision carries risk.

programme.title: Into the Wild India S1E5 -Rana: Queen of the Jungle / 深入印度 第5集 - 叢林虎媽
programme.desc: One of the most iconic animals on Earth stalks the jungles of India: the Bengal Tiger. Over the course of a single day, we follow the fortunes of one mother and her three young cubs. She must provide enough food for her family to stay alive.

programme.title: Big Cats, Small World S1E1 -Summer Cubs / 大貓小世界 第1集 - 夏日幼獅
programme.desc: Welcome spring on the Gomoti River, where cheetah mum Phefo and lion mum Tshaba teach their cubs survival skills and keep them out of the jaws of the big male cats. See lion king Molelo go into battle while leopard Senatia tries to ensure his legacy.

programme.title: Big Cats, Small World S1E2 -Surviving the Flood / 大貓小世界 第2集 - 洪水倖存記
programme.desc: Track Molelo's pride, who are exhausted by cub care when the winter floods arrive. Check on the cheetah cubs, who make a difficult decision, and witness a scary encounter that makes leopard mum Sephiri choose between her old family and her new cubs.

programme.title: Aussie Snake Wranglers: Deadly Pursuit S1E6 -Home Invasion / 澳洲蛇類捕捉隊：死亡追捕 第6集 - 入侵家園
programme.desc: Respond to danger on a rural property with Mick and Adele, who brave a fired-up brown snake. Tread carefully as Jess and Dan extract a python from a play area, and get spooked when a chicken-hunting python squashes Liv’s hand during a tense rescue.

programme.title: Life's Journey S1E3 -Life's Legacies / 生命之旅 第3集 - 「生」火相傳
programme.desc: For every species on earth the right to mate is the purpose of life. Passing on your genes to the next generation is every animal’s legacy. But it’s not easy, it can be a struggle to find a mate and then a fight to gain access. Only the strongest and most determined will win at Luangwa’s mating game.

programme.title: Wildest New Zealand S1E1 -A Tale of Two Penguins / 野性之最紐西蘭 第1集 - 雙鵝記
programme.desc: At the water’s edge a brave group of male penguins gather, preparing to make the dangerous journey ashore. With many threats ahead, there is safety in number and these petite penguins have important business to attend. It’s time to breed and they must find a burrow before the females arrive.

programme.title: Wildest New Zealand S1E2 -Untamed West / 野性之最紐西蘭 第2集 - 狂野西部
programme.desc: New Zealand’s West Coast is like nowhere else on Earth. From glacier-covered mountains to rain-drenched native forests to rough frigid seas, the landscape defies belief. Isolated from the rest of the world, this strip of almost untouched wilderness hides a host of endemic animals. Evolutionary castaways, every one of them is a rare ecological jewel. From alpine parrots and shy penguins to mammal-like kiwis and ancient eels. To survive the conditions the wildlife here has to be hardy, cunning and resourceful. A journey along the West Coast reveals the beauty of this land, and the trials and tribulations of the wildlife that live here.

programme.title: Wildest New Zealand S1E3 -Wild Fortresses / 野性之最紐西蘭 第3集 - 曠野堡壘
programme.desc: In New Zealand, two wild fortresses protect the vulnerable native animals: One a remote island protected by a moat of saltwater, the other a hilltop citadel surrounded by a predator-proof barrier. This is the story of these delicate sanctuaries and the life that thrives within them.

programme.title: Wildest New Zealand S1E4 -Ocean Legacy / 野性之最紐西蘭 第4集 - 海洋遺產
programme.desc: Spring on New Zealand’s east coast is a time of promise for the New Zealand Fur Seal and the Norther Royal Albatross. They’ve returned to their land to breed. But harsh terrain, fickle weather and hungry predators will conspire to make lives difficult for them. Only the strongest will survive to carry forward their legacy.

programme.title: Wildest New Zealand S1E5 -Creepiest Crawlies / 野性之最紐西蘭 第5集 - 最詭異的爬蟲
programme.desc: New Zealand’s isolated islands are famed as an unusual paradise, home to a variety of unique wildlife. Best known for its flightless birds, ancient reptiles and coastal mammals, a closer look reveals another world. A land of miniature monsters, Lilliputian predators and tiny terrors that lead remarkable lives, where every hunter is also the hunted and survival is always a giant struggle. Journey into the undergrowth and discover life on a different scale. From giant carnivorous centipedes and nocturnal crickets to fishing spiders and glowing worms with silken traps. Weird and wonderful, these unsung heroes are Wildest New Zealand’s Creepiest Crawlies.

programme.title: Alaskan Summer / 阿拉斯加的夏天
programme.desc: Nearly 20 hours of sunlight a day feed the season of abundance. Warmth unlocks water from the glaciers, ice caves and waterfalls. The water crashes into countless streams of the Inside Passage, feeding forest and wildlife alike. From June to August, Alaska becomes a paradise for it’s wildlife.

programme.title: Malawi Wildlife Rescue S1E6 -Catch Me if You Can / 馬拉威野生拯救隊 第6集 - 來追我
programme.desc: Join the rescue as Amanda and Mandy try every trick in the book to help a snared hyena, a lion threatens a village, and the team's plan to release a troop of 13 monkeys is thwarted by last minute surgery and some crafty escape artists.

programme.title: Reef Wrecks S1E1 -Reef Wrecks of Bonaire / 「礁」來船禍 第1集 - 博奈爾礁石沉船
programme.desc: Bonaire’s fringing reef is home to thousands of species of corals, fish and other marine animals. It is also home to a collection of stunning shipwrecks. These wrecks evolve over time, becoming artificial reefs that support an incredibly diverse marine habitat.

programme.title: Reef Wrecks S1E2 -Florida Keys Shipwreck Trail / 「礁」來船禍 第2集 - 佛羅里達群島沉船小徑
programme.desc: The Florida Keys is the first line of defence for the southern US. With a rich naval history and a coastal lifestyle, it’s easy to believe locals who claim these waters are home to as many as 1000 shipwrecks.

programme.title: Reef Wrecks S1E3 -Bahamas Hollywood Wrecks / 「礁」來船禍 第3集 - 巴哈馬好萊塢廢墟
programme.desc: The Bahamas is known as the “underwater movie capital of the world”. Hollywood has been coming here for decades, making epic movies and TV shows in its crystal clear waters, leaving behind a host of cinematic shipwrecks.

programme.title: Reef Wrecks S1E4 -Reef Wrecks of Roatan / 「礁」來船禍 第4集 - 羅丹島礁石沉船
programme.desc: This island of the coast of Honduras stands out as a vacation resort hot spot. But it’s not just the sun and sand that brings the tourists in droves. It’s actually a diver’s paradise with shipwrecks scattered from all corners of the the island.

programme.title: Wildlife Icons S2E1 -The Clean Up Crew / 野生動物明星 第1集 - 清理人員
programme.desc: Winter in Marakele National Park is one of the scarcest, but also most plentiful, times of the year. See how a giraffe’s demise becomes a source of life for the region’s vultures, whose survival depends on the decaying flesh of animals like these.

programme.title: Wildlife Icons S2E2 -Fantastic Frogs / 野生動物明星 第2集 - 神奇蛙
programme.desc: Cape Town, South Africa is home to twenty types of frogs, but many are threatened by urban development. Meet a variety of the region’s species as we follow western leopard toads on their tenuous journey to breed in the city’s shrinking wetlands.

programme.title: Wildlife Icons S2E3 -Elephant Story / 野生動物明星 第3集 - 大象物語
programme.desc: Once superabundant, African Elephant populations have declined drastically due to hunting. Get an in-depth look into the lives of the most powerful land mammals on the planet, and see what parks like Addo and Tembe are doing to preserve their future.

programme.title: The Hungry Games: Alaska's Big Bear Challenge S1E1 -Welcome to the Tundra / 飢餓遊戲：阿拉斯加的大熊挑戰 第1集 - 歡迎來到苔原
programme.desc: Wake up post-hibernation with 7 ravenous bears as Stage 1 of the competition kicks off. Battle wolves with new mom BoldFace, see tiny Stomper vie for power and Blondie’s love, and stand back as grizzled vet Bernie brawls with clueless teen Casanova.

programme.title: The Hungry Games: Alaska's Big Bear Challenge S1E2 -Slammin' Salmon / 飢餓遊戲：阿拉斯加的大熊挑戰 第2集 - 鮭魚大戰
programme.desc: Join the frantic dash to cash in on July’s salmon run with the Stage 1 winners and some tough new recruits. Tag along on BigBoi's food-finding road trip, welcome QuadMom and RedBack to the feast, and see if BoldFace can keep her surviving cub safe.

programme.title: The Hungry Games: Alaska's Big Bear Challenge S1E3 -So Long and Thanks for All the Fish / 飢餓遊戲：阿拉斯加的大熊挑戰 第3集 - 再見了，也謝謝所有魚兒
programme.desc: Bundle up as an icy October storm complicates the race to the finish line. See Big Boi bounce after a stumble before tragedy hits QuadMom, and cheer as fan fave BoldFace hits her stride despite her clingy kid, Raccoon. But who will wear the crown?

programme.title: In for the Kill / 致命奇襲
programme.desc: Marvel at the clever ways predators use cunning, agility, and breakneck speed when taking down prey. Witness luring behaviours and see how some killers hide in plain sight, while others put weaponry or chemical warfare to work to bring dinner home.

programme.title: Mysteries of Evolution S1E1 -Head & Neck / 進化的奧秘 第1集 - 頭與脖子
programme.desc: Have you ever wondered why mandrills have such colorful faces, why vultures are bald, or even why hammerheads have, well, hammer-shaped heads? Discover how animals managed to survive by evolving from the neck up.

programme.title: Wild Side of the Moon S1E1 -Dining By Moonlight / 月球野性面 第1集 - 月下晚餐
programme.desc: Explore how lunar phases set the rhythm for an endless contest between predator and prey. Soar by moonlight with colugos, gorge on a shellfish feast with macaques, and watch a prowling pride of lions try to turn a baby elephant into dinner.

programme.title: Wild Side of the Moon S1E2 -Moonlit Romance / 月球野性面 第2集 - 月光情緣
programme.desc: Visit a world of romance and adventure under the stars. Fall in love with sage grouse mating dances, see a pair of arctic fox lovers reunite, float among spawning fish on a coral reef, and visit the moonlit breeding ponds of blacksmith tree frogs.

programme.title: Big Cats: Nine Lives S1E1 -Lions / 大貓九命 第1集 - 獅子
programme.desc: Chart the lion’s nine stages of life, from defenseless cub to confident adult to aging exile. See how rivalry, hunger, and pride dynamics shape its life on the Serengeti, and witness the loyalty and cooperation that make this social cat unique.

programme.title: Superbeast S1E3 -Super Senses / 超獸 第3集 - 超感官
programme.desc: Experience animal abilities that are beyond human reach. See how saltwater crocodiles detect the tiniest movement with their pressure-sensitive domes, discover a pigeon’s internal GPS system, and use a seventh sense to detect prey with dolphins.

programme.title: Superbeast S1E4 -Deadly Deeds / 超獸 第4集 - 致命行為
programme.desc: Deploy biochemical weaponry with nature’s most cunning and resilient fighters. Unleash venomous bites with Komodo dragons, resist poisonous foes with mongoose mobs, and see birds use bone-crushing force to counter poisonous attacks.

programme.title: Wild Latin America S1E3 -Realm of the Spectacled Bear / 拉丁美生态奥秘 第3集 - 眼鏡熊的國度
programme.desc: Get to know South America’s only bear species. Witness the shy and charismatic spectacled bear play, forage, and look for mates at the secluded Chaparri Ecological Reserve in Northern Peru.

programme.title: Reef Wrecks S1E5 -Mexico's Artificial Reefs / 「礁」來船禍 第5集 - 墨西哥的人造礁
programme.desc: From opportunistic pirate ships, to well-armed navy vessels, Mexico’s Yucatan Peninsula is steeped in maritime history.

programme.title: Big Cats: Nine Lives S1E2 -Tigers / 大貓九命 第2集 - 老虎
programme.desc: Navigate the forest with a tiny cub, watch young adults claim their territory, and witness the inevitable exile of aging hunters. Discover how instinct and stealth help the tiger survive in its solitary world, where every decision carries risk.

programme.title: Ningaloo: Australia's Ocean Wonder S1E1 -Collisions / 寧格魯：澳大利亞的海洋奇觀 第1集 - 碰撞
programme.desc: Observe the natural and human forces that have shaped Ningaloo Reef, Cape Range, and Exmouth Gulf with Tim, Traditional Owners, and other experts. Check out a million-year-old fossil reef, a gargantuan fish, and a ray that packs quite a punch.

programme.title: Ningaloo: Australia's Ocean Wonder S1E2 -Connections / 寧格魯：澳大利亞的海洋奇觀 第2集 - 連接
programme.desc: Follow scientists and Traditional Owners as they map out ecological links, migratory pathways, and interspecies bonds that conserve Ningaloo’s biodiversity. Frolic with whales, float among seaweed islands, and see archaeologists nix a settler myth.

programme.title: Shark Squad S1E1 -Island of the White Shark / 鯊魚小隊 第1集 - 白鯊島
programme.desc: Off Guadalupe Island, Mexico, top shark ecologist Mauricio Hoyos attempts a television first. Get a unique view as he attaches a camera to the dorsal fin of a great white, revealing how it swims, hunts, and ultimately strikes its prey.

programme.title: Tales from Zambia S2E1 -The Woodland Troop / 尚比亞野生故事 第1集 - 林地部隊
programme.desc: In this small patch of woodland, two young monkeys face the toughest time of their lives. As they find their place in the world, they must learn which neighbors are allies, and which are foes. Who to trust, and who to avoid. They will suffer loss, and gain friends, as they discover what it means to be part of the Woodland Troop.

programme.desc: Climate change is our defining crisis, and it is happening even faster than we thought. But we're not powerless to stop it. With climate change reaching irreversible heights, now is the time for bold collective action. The climate emergency is a race we are losing, but it is a race we can win.

programme.desc: Billy throws down in a no-holds-barred cage match with one of the North's most feared predators, then teams up with trapper Ben for a dawn-to-dusk eviction of raccoons from clients' homes.

programme.title: Billy Goes North S1E2 -Henhouse of Horrors / Billy Goes North 第2集 - Henhouse of Horrors

programme.title: Extreme Animal Transport S1E7 -Elephants Pt2 Across Borders / Extreme Animal Transport 第7集 - Elephants Pt2 Across Borders
programme.desc: After capturing and loading 30 African Elephants into their transport crates, the convoy is finally ready for the long journey ahead. It’s a 50-hour non-stop drive from South Africa to Mozambique. The team must arrive at Zinave National Park before sunset on day 2 to safely offload the elephants. However, a late departure and unexpected delays at the borders means they could be facing offloading the elephants under only the light of the moon. Not ideal for the exhausted drivers and the wild elephants who are ready to get out of their transportation crates and explore their new home.

programme.title: Extreme Animal Transport S1E8 -Air Horse One / Extreme Animal Transport 第8集 - Air Horse One
programme.desc: A variety of Australian horses are purchased from Singapore investors and annually a cargo plane with up to 50 horses are flown from Sydney Airport to Manilla Airport. The horses range from race horses to miniature ponies to Clydesdales. A mission like this takes meticulous planning. Cameron from Equine International Airfreight won’t let one piece of incorrect paperwork stall his mission. Each horse has its own documentation, if one paper is scrutinised by customs it will mean game over for the mission. Even the custom designed horse crates are scrutinised by officials. The final veterinary checks are undertaken by a government vet at quarantine and the horses are washed prior to the trip. The first leg of the journey is a one-hour drive on a convoy of four semi-trailers moving from quarantine to the airport. programme.title: Extreme Animal Transport S1E5 -Rhino / Extreme Animal Transport 第5集 - Rhino
programme.desc: At 9 years of age Kifaru is already a well-travelled Southern White Rhino. He was born in New Zealand at Hamilton Zoo as part of their Rhino breeding programmed. Then in 2014, at five years of age, he was moved across the Tasman Sea to Australia to the National Zoo and Aquarium. After four years in the country’s capital zoo, it’s time for him to move again. This time, getting him into the transportation crate is not easy but the team are ready with plans A – Z.

programme.title: Extreme Animal Transport S1E6 -Elephants Pt1 African Elephants / Extreme Animal Transport 第6集 - Elephants Pt1 African Elephants
programme.desc: Derek Milburn runs NGO Elephants Rhinos and People, which, over the course of a year will transport 250 elephants from South Africa to Mozambique via road. The current location of the herd is getting overcrowded which could eventually be dangerous to both elephants and people in surrounding villages. This first mission will involve 25-30 elephants the number will vary depending on how many ERP’s team find in the herd. Day one of the mission and the trucks get stuck in mud before reaching the elephants. A helicopter flies above darting the herd with a tranquilizer. They must dart the females first, to ensure the rest of the herd stay, darting a male accidentally means the herd could split and be lost altogether. They must be careful not to leave one of the family behind, this would mean disaster for the abandoned animal. The elephants are then lifted upside down with a helicopter onto their crates. They cross two border checkpoints crossing into Swaziland and Mozambique. Derek has his p

programme.title: Hollywood Weapons S5E1 -Terry's Lethal Weapon / Hollywood Weapons 第1集 - Terry's Lethal Weapon
programme.desc: Terry and Larry tackle the epic Lethal Weapon series, testing four different scenes. Can a surfboard act as a projectile going through a car windshield and killing the bad guy? Can a 9mm bullet go through a bulldozer bucket to stop the driver? And will a AK47 be able to fire under water?

programme.title: Hollywood Weapons S5E2 -Jean Claude Van Schappert / Hollywood Weapons 第2集 - Jean Claude Van Schappert
programme.desc: Terry enters the world of slow-mo and explosions, trying to imitate Jean Claude in Hard Target. Terry and Larry will be testing five scenes from the Hard Target films--one of which will make you never look through a peep hole again!

programme.title: Hollywood Weapons S5E3 -S-Mart / Hollywood Weapons 第3集 - S-Mart

programme.desc: A 44-ton Artic straddling the central reservation of the M1 is a rush hour headache for Crouch Recovery Incident Manager Steve and one of the youngest Recovery Ops on the team, Pat. programme.title: Extreme Animal Transport S1E9 -Horses & Dogs / Extreme Animal Transport 第9集 - Horses & Dogs
programme.desc: An Australian Outback Adventure. Tom Curtain is a professional horse trainer and Golden guitar winning singer/songwriter. He is also the founder of Katherine Outback Experience, a 90-minute horse and dog show that celebrates life in outback Australia. The show takes place at Tom’s ranch in Katherine, Northern Territory from April to the end of October, and in Pinjarra, a town in the south-west of Western Australia from November to March. It’s the end of March and it is time to go home. This will be a 4000km road trip through outback Australia. The resting points are not planned but Tom and Annabel have a large web of connections on stations and showgrounds that can be called upon at last minute for a place to rest the animals. Travelling with 6 horses and 12 dogs, these resting spots are a place for the animals to stretch tired legs have a drink and feed. It’s an adventure they look forward to but the extreme road and weather conditions comes with its own set of challenges.

programme.title: Extreme Animal Transport S1E10 -Camels / Extreme Animal Transport 第10集 - Camels
programme.desc: John runs Red Sun Camels in Broome, a tourist town in the north of Western Australia where visitors can experience a sunset camel ride along the famous Cable Beach. As his business expands, he needs seven more camels to add to the group, to enable his other camels to rest. But camels don’t come ready to be ridden by humans. Without extensive training they can be very dangerous, and the risk of them kicking a tourist could mean serious injury or even death. On the other side of Australia, 5000kms away, Peter has been commissioned by John to train and deliver seven wild camels. Known throughout Australia as the camel whisperer, Peter’s love of the animal is evident. Each of his seven beloved camels has a unique personality. It's a four-day transport. Due to Australia’s strict biosecurity laws, the camels have to pass a quarantine checkpoint at Kununurra, on the border of the Northern Territory and Western Australia. programme.title: The Force of Nature 2022 S1E1 -The Force of Nature / The Force of Nature 2022 第1集 - The Force of Nature
programme.desc: Climate change is our defining crisis, and it is happening even faster than we thought. But we're not powerless to stop it. The impacts of climate change are felt in every corner of the world. Increased temperatures are causing environmental disasters. The sea levels are rising, the Arctic is melting, coral reefs are dying, oceans are acidifying, and forests are burning. It is clear that business as usual is not an option. With climate change reaching irreversible heights, now is the time for bold collective action. The climate emergency is a race we are losing, but it is a race we can win.

programme.desc: Undercover ATF and DEA agents are reminded to never judge a book by its cover and to always be on their toes. Even small-time suspects have the potential to unleash terror.

programme.title: Court Cam (S6) - #160:6 E160 / 法庭現場 - 第160集
programme.desc: A look at some of the wildest courtroom moments. A defendant flips off a judge; a baby interrupts a hearing; a mom sounds off on one of the men responsible for her daughter's death; and more.

programme.title: The Agenda
programme.desc: A weekly talk-show looking beyond the headlines and “accepted wisdom” to find the real story. Hosted by award-winning journalist and presenter Stephen Cole, The Agenda quite simply sets The Agenda . You won't find the same-old talking heads recycling platitudes; instead thought-provoking guests to debate and explore key issues of today's world. Using virtual reality graphics to bring subjects to life, Stephen will navigate through subjects ranging from “Prove That Climate Change Exists” to “Who Will Win the Race to Space”. Opposing views will be given opportunity to flourish and develop into a meaningful conversation. The Agenda: No nonsense talk; Challenging perceptions.

Bebefinn: The Big Animal World S1E5 -Hide-And-Seek, The Giant Pacific Octopus / Bebefinn: The Big Animal World 第5集 - Hide-And-Seek, The Giant Pacific Octopus
programme.desc: Bebefinn is playing hide and seek, just like the Giant Pacific Octopus does!

programme.title: Andy's Baby Animal Missions S1E14 -Andy And The Tiger Cubs / Andy's Baby Animal Missions 第14集 - Andy And The Tiger Cubs
programme.desc: Andy, Jen and Scout head to the Bandhavgarh tiger reserve in India on a baby animal mission to track down a female tiger and her new born cubs. Along the way, our team outwit a sloth that strays dangerously close to the den where the cubs are resting.

programme.title: Hey Duggee S5E6 -The Why Badge / Hey Duggee 第6集 - The Why Badge
programme.desc: Why do my feet hurt?', Tag asks Duggee. While Duggee has a think, he tells them 'why' is a great question, and the Squirrels are quick to follow up.

programme.title: Hey Duggee S5E7 -The Sibling Badge / Hey Duggee 第7集 - The Sibling Badge
programme.desc: Roly reveals he's expecting a new baby brother or sister, and the Squirrels have questions.

programme.title: Hey Duggee S5E8 -The Monster Badge / Hey Duggee 第8集 - The Monster Badge
programme.desc: The Squirrels want to help Plinky find her scary side. Fortunately, Duggee has his monster badge.

programme.title: Hey Duggee S5E9 -The Diary Badge / Hey Duggee 第9集 - The Diary Badge
programme.desc: The Squirrels find a dusty, old book behind a cupboard... it's Duggee's diary from when he was a teenager! The Squirrels are keen to write diaries of their own.

programme.title: Hey Duggee S5E10 -The Metal Detector Badge / Hey Duggee 第10集 - The Metal Detector Badge
programme.desc: Roly needs a wee, but the door is locked and Duggee has mislaid the key. Not to worry, Duggee has his metal detector.

programme.title: Hey Duggee's Squirrel Club S1E9 -Ladybird's Gameshow / Hey Duggee's Squirrel Club 第9集 - Ladybird's Gameshow
programme.desc: Spot the odd one out or guess who lives here. A great memory tip from Duggee, an edition of The Agony and Eggstacy, and how to draw Enid - down to her last whisker.

programme.title: Hey Duggee's Squirrel Club S1E10 -Campfire Choir / Hey Duggee's Squirrel Club 第10集 - Campfire Choir
programme.desc: Today at Squirrel Club, there are all sorts of comparisons to learn - from small to smallest, hungry to hungriest, and Duggee to Duggiest!

programme.title: Hey Duggee's Squirrel Club S1E11 -Stick Time / Hey Duggee's Squirrel Club 第11集 - Stick Time
programme.desc: How many siblings does Norrie have? What's Duggee's favourite badge? What does everyone do on Fridays? Squirrel Club has the answers!

programme.title: Hey Duggee's Squirrel Club S1E12 -Calm Down / Hey Duggee's Squirrel Club 第12集 - Calm Down
programme.desc: Water, water, everywhere - there's a flood in our hospital soap opera! Grown-up Tag the firefighter splashes around. It's a good job grown-up Happy the lifeguard is on hand

programme.title: Hey Duggee's Squirrel Club S1E13 -Master Of Puppets / Hey Duggee's Squirrel Club 第13集 - Master Of Puppets
programme.desc: At Squirrel Club, there's a story told in blocks, the tale of a first tooth, a fable about changing emotions, and a yarn involving the Squirrels as puppets.

programme.title: Teletubbies S1E92 -Feeling Better / Teletubbies 第92集 - Feeling Better
programme.desc: It's time to wake up but Tinky Winky isn't feeling well. Soon, Tinky Winky feels better but now Dipsy, Laa-Laa and Po don't feel well.

programme.title: Teletubbies Ready Steady Go! S1E6 -I Can Be Anything / Teletubbies Ready Steady Go! 第6集 - I Can Be Anything
programme.desc: Join the dance party with the Teletubbies! Tinky Winky, Dipsy, Laa-Laa and Po dance and sing and follow their dreams.

programme.title: Bluey S3E33 -Granny Mobile / Bluey 第33集 - Granny Mobile
programme.desc: Muffin is playing Grouchy Granny at a garage sale, making Dad push her on an old mobility scooter, but when a real Grouchy Granny wants to buy it, Muffin won't budge.

programme.title: Bluey S3E34 -Space / Bluey 第34集 - Space
programme.desc: Mackenzie, Jack and Rusty are playing as astronauts on a mission to Mars, but during their journey, Mackenzie keeps going missing and no one knows why, not even Mackenzie.

programme.title: Bluey S3E35 -Smoochy Kiss / Bluey 第35集 - Smoochy Kiss
programme.desc: Bluey and Bingo want Dad all to themselves and will not let Mum have a smoochy kiss. They try to hide him all around the house, but Mum is desperate to spend a little romance time with her husband.

programme.title: Bluey S3E36 -Dirt / Bluey 第36集 - Dirt
programme.desc: Judo desperately wants to play in the dirt with Bluey and Bingo, but she is not supposed to get herself dirty.

programme.title: Bluey S3E37 -The Decider / Bluey 第37集 - The Decider
programme.desc: The Heelers and Lucky's family get together to watch the big game, a fun family experiences that gets a little tense.

programme.title: Thomas & Friends S23E15 -First Day On Sodor! / Thomas & Friends 第15集 - First Day On Sodor!
programme.desc: Darcy the tunnel boring machine makes some mistakes on her first day, but she soon makes up for it when everyone sees what she can really do.

programme.title: Thomas & Friends S23E16 -Rangers Of The Rails / Thomas & Friends 第16集 - Rangers Of The Rails
programme.desc: A bit bored by her surroundings, Emily longs to go on a fun adventure and experience something new and exciting. It's not long before her wish is granted.

programme.title: Thomas & Friends S23E17 -Lorenzo's Solo / Thomas & Friends 第17集 - Lorenzo's Solo
programme.desc: Lorenzo decides to play a dangerous trick on his loyal coach Beppe.

programme.title: Go Jetters S3E38 -Go Jet Academy: Weather Prediction Predicament / Go Jetters 第38集 - Go Jet Academy: Weather Prediction Predicament
programme.desc: There's a storm brewing after Glitch's fake weather report puts the cadets in danger.

programme.title: Go Jetters S3E39 -Funky Fireflies, Selangor River, Malaysia / Go Jetters 第39集 - Funky Fireflies, Selangor River, Malaysia
programme.desc: A trip to see fireflies becomes a rescue when Xuli and Glitch get stuck in a swamp.

programme.title: Go Jetters S3E40 -Pirate Peril, Jamaica / Go Jetters 第40集 - Pirate Peril, Jamaica
programme.desc: Xuli dives into action when Glitch's pirate game puts Lars in danger. Yo-ho Go Jetters go!

programme.title: Mojo Swoptops S1E32 -Cable Car Crisis / Mojo Swoptops 第32集 - Cable Car Crisis
programme.desc: Preston needs rescuing from a stuck cable car. But when the car suddenly starts moving again, Mojo has to ride the cable to chase it down and save poor Preston.

programme.title: Mojo Swoptops S1E33 -Turbo Ted / Mojo Swoptops 第33集 - Turbo Ted
programme.desc: Ted the bus wants to be faster, and Mojo swops every top to try to make it happen. But it's Bo's homemade rocket that gives Ted the boost he needs... all the way into space!

programme.title: Supertato S2E30 -Melon Melon / Supertato 第30集 - Melon Melon
programme.desc: Evil Pea befriends the playful but destructive Baby Watermelon to destroy Tato Tower. Her plan backfires when Baby Watermelon gets cranky.

programme.title: Supertato S2E29 -Freezy Sprinklers / Supertato 第29集 - Freezy Sprinklers
programme.desc: Evil Pea plots to take over the whole supermarket by making fake freezy sprinklers to fool Supertato. But what is her real plan, and will Supertato stop her?

programme.title: Supertato Songs S1E10 -Tatocar Vs Evil Peamobile Song / Supertato Songs 第10集 - Tatocar Vs Evil Peamobile Song
programme.desc: The Tatoteam have the Tatocar and Evil Pea has the Evil Peamobile. But which one of these machines is best? Carrot and Evil Pea have a song to decide.

programme.title: Supertato Songs S1E1 -The Monstertato Song / Supertato Songs 第1集 - The Monstertato Song
programme.desc: Get your spooky veggie vibe on with this frightfully delightful Halloween track!

programme.title: Sigabo[Live] / Sigabo[直播]
programme.desc: The series explores the stark contrast in the lives of two individuals: Gabo (Martin), a spunky, street-smart man from a vibrant, humble community, and Samantha (Montes), a tough, fearless law enforcer from a highly affluent and privileged background. It blends action, romance, and comedy as their paths cross and their different worlds collide.

programme.title: Someone, Someday[Live] / Someone, Someday[直播]
programme.desc: Someone, Someday follows Billy (Kathryn Bernardo), the young CEO of a dating app that empowers women to find their destined true love-while secretly carrying the heartbreak that has kept her from finding her own. Driven by her unwavering love for her friends and family, especially her younger brother who she raised by herself, Billy must confront the wounds she's spent years hiding before she can reclaim her dreams-and finally discover whether someone, someday, was meant for her after all.

programme.title: The Loyalty Game[Live] / The Loyalty Game[直播]
programme.desc: A wife puts her husband to a simple loyalty test, unaware she will unleash a dangerous game of seduction, secrets, and deadly deception. After a troubled night leaves Ana waking up without her husband Ben by her side, she hires Beth to test his loyalty by seducing him. The connivance between wife and loyalty tester soon turns into a dangerous, seductive psychological game of secrets, manipulation, and power play, where loyalty becomes a matter of life and death.

programme.title: The Iron Heart
programme.desc: The Iron Heart follows Apollo Adelantar, an undercover operative with a traumatic past who is assigned to infiltrate a powerful crime syndicate. As he goes deeper into his dangerous mission, Apollo is forced to confront painful truths about his identity, loyalty, and family-especially when trusted allies turn into enemies. Fueled by vengeance, justice, and his desire to protect the innocent, Apollo and his companions face relentless trials that test not only their strength but also their moral convictions.

programme.title: The General's Daughter
programme.desc: Rhian Bonifacio, an AFP military nurse, secretly works as a spy for the man she believes is her father, Santiago Guerrero, who has raised her to seek revenge against military general Marcial de Leon. As Rhian uncovers the truth about her origins, she finds herself torn between loyalty to the family that raised her and her duty to justice, leading to a dangerous conflict involving family, betrayal, and redemption

programme.title: La Vida Lena
programme.desc: La Vida Lena is a revenge drama about Magda, a talented young woman who is bullied because of a facial scar. After creating a successful beauty soap formula, she becomes the target of the powerful Narciso family. Betrayed and stripped of everything she loves, she returns with a new identity and appearance, determined to exact revenge on those who destroyed her life.

programme.title: TV Patrol Global Edition
programme.desc: ABS-CBN's flagship newscast and the country's leading news program in the past two decades, anchored by the most celebrated news team ever assembled in the history of Philippine broadcasting.

programme.title: Santigwar
programme.desc: Hasmin, a young Santigwar who inherited her father's mystical ability to heal and battle supernatural beings, has spent years hunting the aswang clan responsible for her mother's death. When a group of unwitting teenagers arrives in her town, their presence triggers a series of encounters that bring Hasmin face‑to‑face with long‑hidden truths linking her own family to the very monsters she seeks.
